title: Real-Time Streaming Analytics for Predictive Fault Diagnosis in Cyber-Physical Energy Infrastructures
abstractText: Cyber-Physical Energy Infrastructures (CPEIs) are becoming more complex and networked, and therefore there is an increased risk of failures occurring, especially the unexpected ones, thus predictive fault diagnosis becomes imperative to assure reliability and continuity of operations. Conventional methods of diagnosis are based on batch analysis and off-line-work and are exceedingly inadequate to deliver speedily and rapidly accessible understanding to make appropriate real-time decision-making in transient energy arrangements. The study offers a real-time streaming analytics solution that allows the early identification and forecast of faults in CPEIs that involve real-time processing of data streams received by various sources of heterogeneous data, including phasor measurement units (PMUs), smart meters, and SCADAs. It is a framework that incorporates edge computing, distributed stream processing (Apache Kafka and Apache Flink), light machine learning (Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Random Forest classifiers). Edge preprocessing of real-time data is done on edge, and predictive models are updated on the fly to enable low latency anomaly detection and fault classification. It was verified through a simulated 33-bus IEEE test network with injected faults achieving sub-second fault prediction accuracy of up to 96.4 percent. The system is also scalable and fault tolerant when data loads and edge deployment scenarios change. Such findings reveal that the given architecture would work effectively and is scalable to the predictive fault diagnosis of CPEIs, contributing to the resilience of the grid and allowing proactive maintenance approaches in intelligent energy management systems.

title: Kelas Psikoedukasi: Membangun Kesadaran Kesehatan Mental dan Ketangguhan Emosional pada Remaja di Kecamatan Curug, Kota Serang
abstractText: This article discusses a psychoeducational class program themed Mental Health Awareness and Emotional Resilience conducted by KUKERTA students from UIN SMH Banten at SMPN 11 Kota Serang, Curug District. The aim of this program is to improve teenagers' awareness of mental health and to enhance emotional strength. The methods used in this activity include interactive seminars, discussions, ice breaking activities, and reflections with religious counselors. The results of this activity show a very enthusiastic participation from the participants and a development in related understanding.

title: PENINGKATAN PEMAHAMAN BRANDING DIGITAL USAHA MIKRO, KECIL, DAN MENENGAH DI DESA WISATA HARIARA POHAN, KABUPATEN SAMOSIR
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis peningkatan pemahaman branding digital pada pelaku Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM) di Desa Wisata Hariara Pohan, Kabupaten Samosir, melalui kegiatan Workshop Branding Digitalisasi UMKM. Fokus penelitian meliputi kondisi awal pemahaman pelaku UMKM, pelaksanaan penguatan kapasitas, serta perubahan pemahaman setelah kegiatan workshop. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain deskriptif. Data diperoleh melalui observasi, wawancara, dialog, dan dokumentasi selama kegiatan yang dilaksanakan pada 4–20 Agustus 2026. Workshop dilaksanakan melalui penyampaian materi, praktik, dan diskusi mengenai identitas usaha, nama usaha, logo, kemasan, serta pemanfaatan media sosial untuk memperkenalkan dan mempromosikan produk. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pada kondisi awal masih terdapat keterbatasan dalam penggunaan media sosial, mengikuti perkembangan informasi digital, dan menerapkan branding pada usaha. Setelah workshop, pelaku UMKM mulai memahami pentingnya branding serta pemanfaatan media sosial untuk pengenalan dan promosi produk. Penelitian menyimpulkan bahwa penguatan pemahaman branding digital perlu dilakukan secara praktis, kontekstual, dan berkelanjutan melalui pendampingan lanjutan.

title: PENINGKATAN KESADARAN PELAJAR TERHADAP PENGGUNAAN SMARTPHONE, MEDIA SOSIAL, DAN KEAMANAN DIGITAL
abstractText: Perkembangan teknologi digital menjadikan smartphone dan media sosial sebagai bagian penting dalam kehidupan pelajar, tetapi penggunaannya juga menghadirkan berbagai risiko, seperti pelanggaran privasi, cyberbullying, phishing, penyebaran informasi yang tidak benar, dan penggunaan secara berlebihan. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan memperkuat kesadaran pelajar mengenai penggunaan smartphone dan media sosial secara aman, sehat, etis, dan bertanggung jawab. Kegiatan dilaksanakan kepada 175 pelajar kelas XII, terdiri atas 120 pelajar SMA Negeri 1 Aek Kuasan dan 55 pelajar SMK YASPENDA Pulau Rakyat. Metode yang digunakan adalah pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif melalui penyampaian materi secara langsung menggunakan presentasi, interaksi dan pertanyaan sederhana, observasi respons peserta, dokumentasi, serta evaluasi internal. Materi meliputi manfaat smartphone dan media sosial, ancaman digital, perlindungan data pribadi, cyberbullying, phishing, penipuan daring, verifikasi informasi, etika bermedia sosial, privasi, jejak digital, dan penggunaan smartphone secara bijak. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan bahwa pelajar mengikuti kegiatan dengan antusias, aktif merespons materi dan pertanyaan, serta menunjukkan pemahaman berdasarkan pengamatan selama kegiatan. Namun, karena tidak dilakukan pre-test dan post-test, perubahan tingkat kesadaran digital belum dapat diukur secara statistik. Kegiatan ini menunjukkan pentingnya edukasi digital yang dilakukan secara berkelanjutan di lingkungan sekolah.

PEMBERDAYAAN MASYARAKAT MELALUI SOSIALISASI DAN PEMELIHARAAN DRAINASE BERBASIS PARTISIPASI: KAJIAN DI DUSUN III DESA AEK LOBA
abstractText: Drainase yang berfungsi baik sangat penting untuk menjaga kebersihan dan kenyamanan lingkungan permukiman, namun kinerjanya sering menurun akibat penumpukan sampah, sedimentasi, tumbuhan liar, serta rendahnya partisipasi masyarakat. Kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk mengoptimalkan pengelolaan drainase berbasis partisipasi warga di Dusun III Desa Aek Loba, Kecamatan Aek Kuasan. Pendekatan yang digunakan adalah kualitatif deskriptif dengan desain studi kasus. Subjek kegiatan terdiri atas 10 orang warga dan 1 kepala dusun. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi lapangan, wawancara, dan dokumentasi, yang kemudian dianalisis secara deskriptif naratif. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan bahwa kondisi awal saluran mengalami penyumbatan akibat sampah rumah tangga, endapan tanah, dan tumbuhan liar. Setelah pelaksanaan sosialisasi, pemahaman warga mengenai fungsi dan pentingnya pemeliharaan drainase mengalami peningkatan. Aksi pembersihan bersama berhasil memperbaiki kondisi fisik saluran sehingga aliran air menjadi lebih lancar. Kepala dusun berperan strategis sebagai penggerak dan penghubung warga. Dengan demikian, pengelolaan drainase melalui kegiatan partisipatif sederhana mampu meningkatkan kesadaran dan tindakan nyata warga dalam pemeliharaan lingkungan secara berkelanjutan.

title: Uji Stabilitas dan Aktivitas Antibakteri Infused Oil Daun Kelengkeng (Dimocarpus longan L.) terhadap Bakteri Propionibacterium acnes ATCC 6919
abstractText: Jerawat merupakan penyakit inflamasi pada kulit yang berkaitan dengan bakteri Propionibacterium acnes, sehingga diperlukan alternatif bahan herbal yang berpotensi sebagai antibakteri. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengetahui aktivitas antibakteri dan stabilitas infused oil daun kelengkeng (Dimocarpus longan L.) terhadap P. acnes ATCC 6919. Penelitian menggunakan metode eksperimental dengan sampel daun kelengkeng dan bakteri P. acnes ATCC 6919. Pengujian meliputi pembuatan simplisia, ekstraksi, formulasi infused oil, uji mutu fisik, viskositas, pH, iritasi, dan aktivitas antibakteri. Instrumen meliputi viskometer Brookfield, inkubator, autoklaf, oven, blender, dan climatic chamber, sedangkan data diolah menggunakan Microsoft Excel. Hasil menunjukkan ekstrak konsentrasi 50% menghasilkan zona hambat 11,18 mm, 25% sebesar 8,6 mm, dan 17,5% sebesar 7,48 mm. Pada infused oil, F1 menghasilkan 5,8 mm, F2 sebesar 9,5 mm, dan F3 sebesar 11,11 mm. Kesimpulannya, infused oil daun kelengkeng memiliki stabilitas yang baik dan aktivitas antibakteri terhadap P. acnes, dengan F3 sebagai formula terbaik.

title: ANESTHETIC MANAGEMENT OF TWO ADOLESCENT GIRLS UNDERGOING POSTERIOR SPINAL FUSION FOR ADOLESCENT IDIOPATHIC SCOLIOSIS: TWO CASE REPORTS
abstractText: Objective: To describe the perioperative anesthetic management of two adolescent girls undergoing posterior instrumented spinal fusion for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS), with emphasis on neurophysiological monitoring, blood conservation, and postoperative recovery. Methods: Two girls aged 16 and 14 years (ASA physical status I) with progressive idiopathic thoracic scoliosis underwent posterior spinal fusion under general anesthesia. Propofol-based total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) with fentanyl was used, together with arterial pressure monitoring, bispectral index monitoring, motor evoked potentials (MEPs), and somatosensory evoked potentials (SSEPs). Tranexamic acid was administered as part of a blood-conservation strategy. Results: Operative times were 5 hours and 4 hours 30 minutes, with estimated blood losses of 650 mL and 500 mL, respectively; neither patient required transfusion. MEP and SSEP recordings remained stable, and both patients were extubated early without neurological or anesthetic complications. The postoperative courses were uneventful. Conclusion: A coordinated strategy combining propofol-based TIVA, multimodal neurophysiological monitoring, blood-conservation measures, and multimodal analgesia may facilitate safe perioperative management of AIS surgery. As a two-case report, these observations cannot establish the causal effectiveness of any single component.

Movimiento dentario con alineadores transparentes frente a ortodoncia fija: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: comparar los resultados del movimiento dentario ortodóncico obtenidos con alineadores transparentes y con aparatología fija convencional. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con metaanálisis, ensayos clínicos y estudios de cohorte. Resultados: ambos sistemas corrigieron maloclusiones leves y moderadas, pero la aparatología fija logró mejores contactos oclusales y un mejor control del torque; la precisión de los alineadores rondó la mitad del movimiento planificado y fue menor en la extrusión y la rotación; los aditamentos mejoraron el control. Los alineadores produjeron menos dolor y mejor salud periodontal. Conclusión: los alineadores son una alternativa eficaz en casos seleccionados, mientras que la aparatología fija sigue siendo más predecible en los movimientos complejos.

title: Castor Oil as a Renewable Reaction Medium for Sustainable Domino Synthesis of Functionalized Epoxyisoindolyl Ureas
abstractText: Abstract The development of renewable reaction media that can replace conventional organic solvents without affecting reaction performance is highly desirable for the advancement of sustainable chemical processes. In this study, the properties of Castor oil as a bio-based solvent were investigated in the context of a domino multicomponent synthesis of functionalized epoxyisoindolyl ureas. This synthesis involved a tandem condensation/Diels–Alder sequence, with the use of furfurylamine, phenyl isocyanate, and various N-substituted maleimides. In the absence of a catalyst and under mild reaction conditions, the desired products were obtained in satisfactory yields and with generally high diastereoselectivity without the need for chromatographic purification. In the course of the investigation, it was established that among the vegetable oils under consideration, Castor oil demonstrated the highest reaction efficiency. Furthermore, it was ascertained that this oil could be easily recovered and reused. Its superior performance is attributed to its high hydrogen-bonding capability and favorable Hansen solubility parameter profile, which enhance substrate solubilization and facilitate hydrogen bond-assisted organization of the reacting species. The use of Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) monitoring and DFT calculations has provided support for a proposed mechanism in which the rapid formation of a urea intermediate occurs prior to the intermolecular cycloaddition reaction. In comparison with conventional stepwise protocols, the present methodology integrates multiple bond-forming events into a single operation, thereby reducing purification requirements while employing a renewable and recyclable reaction medium. The findings of this study demonstrate that Castor oil provides an effective platform for sustainable domino synthesis and highlight the potential of vegetable-oil-based solvents for greener multicomponent transformations.

title: Cambios bucales durante el embarazo: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre los cambios bucales que se producen durante el embarazo, sus mecanismos, sus consecuencias gestacionales y su prevención. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas y narrativas, un estudio observacional, un ensayo clínico y consensos. Resultados: el embarazo aumentó la inflamación gingival sin un aumento proporcional de la placa, por efecto de los estrógenos y la progesterona sobre los vasos, la respuesta inmunitaria y la microbiota. Los cambios salivales y la exposición ácida favorecen la caries y la erosión. La enfermedad periodontal se asoció con resultados gestacionales adversos, aunque su tratamiento no demostró prevenirlos con claridad. Conclusión: el control de placa y la educación prenatal son las medidas con mejor respaldo.

title: Preoperative whey protein and exercise ımprove early recovery after total hip arthroplasty: a randomized controlled trial
abstractText: Abstract Background Total hip arthroplasty (THA) is an effective surgical procedure for treating hip osteoarthritis; however, postoperative recovery may be complicated by impaired functional capacity, delayed mobilization, and prolonged hospital stay. Preoperative multimodal strategies combining nutritional support and exercise may improve recovery outcomes. Objective This study aimed to evaluate the effects of a combined multimodal prehabilitation protocol (preoperative whey protein supplementation plus structured exercise) on metabolic parameters, functional independence, and length of hospital stay in patients undergoing THA. Methods This randomized controlled trial included 71 patients scheduled for total hip arthroplasty (THA). Participants were randomly assigned to either the intervention group (n = 36), which received a 14-day preoperative program consisting of oral whey protein supplementation (25 g/day) and a partially supervised, home-based structured exercise protocol (comprising an initial face-to-face instruction followed by telephone-guided monitoring), or the control group (n = 35), which received standard care. Baseline habitual physical activity levels were recorded for both groups. Data were collected preoperatively and on postoperative days 3 and 5. Functional outcomes were assessed using the Barthel Index, while biochemical markers included C-reactive protein (CRP) and albumin levels. Statistical analyses included ANCOVA (adjusting for age and chronic diseases) and Repeated-Measures ANOVA for longitudinal markers. Results Significant Group × Time interaction effects were observed for CRP ( p < 0.001) and albumin ( p = 0.008), indicating different postoperative trajectories between the intervention and control groups. After adjustment for age and chronic disease status, the intervention group demonstrated significantly higher Barthel Index scores than the control group ( p < 0.001; ηp 2 = 0.31), with a large standardized between-group effect (Cohen’s d = 1.59). Length of hospital stay was significantly shorter in the intervention group (5.11 ± 1.38 vs. 6.94 ± 1.72 days); this difference remained statistically significant after adjustment for age and chronic disease status ( p = 0.004). Conclusion Combined preoperative multimodal prehabilitation integrating whey protein supplementation with structured exercise demonstrates promising efficacy in improving early functional recovery and reducing length of hospital stay in patients undergoing THA. While baseline imbalances necessitate a cautious interpretation of the effect magnitude, this integrated strategy shows strong clinical potential for perioperative optimization. Trial registration : The study was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (Identifier: NCT07329010) on 25 September 2025.

RULE-BASED ENERGY MANAGEMENT OF A STANDALONE PV-BATTERY SYSTEM UNDER ONE-MONTH SOLAR RESOURCE VARIABILITY: A CASE STUDY IN SENEGAL
abstractText: Energy management is a key factor in the reliability and performance of photovoltaic (PV) systems coupled with battery storage for rural electrification. Unlike studies based on representative days, this work investigates the operation of a PV–battery system over a continuous 28-day period (672 h) to assess the influence of day-to-day weather variations on its behaviour. The system consists of a 36.6 kWp PV generator, a battery storage system (648 Ah, 200 V), and a bidirectional buck–boost converter exchanging energy between the DC bus and the batteries. Simulations were carried out in MATLAB/Simulink using hourly solar irradiation and temperature profiles measured in Senegal in February 2005, and a domestic load profile. Maximum power point tracking is performed with the incremental conductance algorithm, while a PI controller maintains the DC bus voltage at its 395 V reference. A rule-based energy management strategy coordinates PV generation, storage and load supply according to the instantaneous power balance and the battery state of charge (SOC). Results show that the DC bus voltage remains globally close to its reference despite fluctuations in solar irradiation, apart from a transient drop to about 260 V around 275 h. The battery SOC stays close to 50% over the whole month, indicating stable operation of the strategy under the simulated conditions. This study provides a basis for analysing the sizing and operation of PV–battery systems in the sub-Saharan African context.

title: Efectos del piercing oral en la salud bucal: complicaciones locales inmediatas y tardías
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las complicaciones locales inmediatas y tardías del piercing oral en la mucosa y los tejidos blandos. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025), complementada con estudios previos de referencia; se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones, estudios observacionales, estudios microbiológicos, una intervención educativa y reportes de caso. Resultados: las complicaciones inmediatas más descritas fueron el dolor, el edema, el sangrado y la infección local. Entre las tardías destacaron las lesiones traumáticas e hiperplásicas de la mucosa y la colonización bacteriana de la joya, influida por su material. Se documentaron casos de endocarditis infecciosa. Los portadores mostraron un conocimiento limitado de los riesgos. Conclusión: el piercing oral genera complicaciones locales frecuentes y prevenibles que justifican la orientación profesional antes y después de su colocación.

title: ASSESSMENT OF THE ECONOMIC VIABILITY OF TRADITIONAL FISH-PIT PRODUCTION SYSTEMS IN THE LOWER OUEME VALLEY IN BENIN
abstractText: Fish ponds are a traditional fisheries production system widely practiced in the Lower Ouémé Valley in southern Benin. This activity contributes to the income of riparian communities, food security, and the conservation of wetlands, but its economic profitability remains insufficiently documented. This study aims to analyze the economic profitability of fish pit operations in the municipalities of Adjohoun, Aguégués, Bonou, and Dangbo. Socioeconomic data were collected from 366 producers through field surveys. Profitability was assessed using Gordon’s static model, while the determinants of producers’ income were analyzed using the Cobb-Douglas econometric model. The results show that during the first year of operation, the activity exhibits negative profitability, with a deficit ranging from 0 to 750,000 FCFA per fish pit. This situation is mainly due to high initial development costs, particularly labor-related expenses. The econometric analysis reveals that labor costs have a significant negative impact on producers’ income. In contrast, the area under cultivation, production yield, and the unit selling price of fish have a significant positive effect on income. Starting in the second year of operation, fish ponds become economically profitable, with profits ranging from 30,000 to 120,000 FCFA per pond, thanks to lower production costs, particularly those related to labor. The Cobb-Douglas model indicates that the area under cultivation, yield, and the selling price per kilogram of fish account for 98% of the variation in producers’ income. The remaining 2% is attributable to unobserved factors such as hydrological variations, climatic conditions, seasonal fluctuations, and certain technical parameters that are difficult to measure. These results show that fish pond farming is an economically viable activity in the medium term, despite the financial constraints observed during the initial setup phase. They highlight the need to strengthen technical, organizational, and financial support for producers, particularly by facilitating access to means of production, reducing development costs, and improving management practices. Such support would help increase the productivity of fish ponds, maximize farmers’ incomes, and ensure the economic and environmental sustainability of this traditional practice in the Lower Ouémé Valley.

title: ADAPTIVE LIGHTWEIGHT STRUCTURAL DESIGN FRAMEWORK FOR ALUMINIUM TRAILER PLATFORMS USING MULTI-OBJECTIVE FINITE ELEMENT OPTIMIZATION AND MANUFACTURABILITY CONSTRAINTS
abstractText: Adaptive lightweight design of aluminum trailer platforms is technically significant, as road-load requirements, payload, stiffness, fatigue, buckling, and manufacturability requirements often conflict. The review critically summarizes the published journal literature concerning multi-objective finite element optimization, manufacturing-oriented topology optimization, joining of aluminum, stress/buckling control and lightweight vehicle-related structural design. The literature review demonstrates that effective lightweight designs were not necessarily achieved by minimizing weight, but rather by considering the following factors: load-path continuity, minimum member size, weld access, structural feasibility of the trailer platform, interaction between the deck and the trailer platform, fatigue-prone details and the avoidance of local buckling. Existing research is well-grounded in the computational aspects, but is scattered over vehicle crashworthiness, aerospace topology optimization, additive manufacturing limitations, and general aluminum fabrication research. Validation of trailers, multi-objective optimization considering fatigue and the rules of manufacture of welded and extruded aluminum remain insufficiently developed. Such a framework should therefore integrate finite element fidelity, surrogate model adaptation, manufacturable geometry production, and production-based constraint screening.

title: Identifikasi Gen Hemoglobin A (HbA) pada Pasien Gagal Ginjal Kronik (GGK) di Rumah Sakit Santa Elisabeth Medan Tahun 2026
abstractText: : Gagal Ginjal Kronik (GGK) merupakan kondisi yang dapat disertai penurunan kadar hemoglobin akibat gangguan fungsi ginjal, sedangkan identifikasi gen Hemoglobin A (HbA) diperlukan untuk mengetahui keberadaan fragmen DNA target. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengidentifikasi gen HbA pada pasien GGK di Rumah Sakit Santa Elisabeth Medan Tahun 2026. Penelitian menggunakan desain deskriptif analitik dengan pemeriksaan laboratorik melalui isolasi DNA, Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR), dan elektroforesis gel agarosa. Populasi penelitian adalah pasien GGK yang mengalami anemia dan menjalani hemodialisis, dengan sampel sebanyak 20 pasien menggunakan teknik total sampling. Instrumen meliputi peralatan isolasi DNA, PCR, elektroforesis, dan gel documentation. Data dianalisis secara deskriptif menggunakan IBM SPSS 26 berdasarkan kadar Hb dan visualisasi pita DNA. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan rata-rata kadar Hb sebesar 8,9 g/dL dengan rentang 5,7 hingga 10,8 g/dL. Elektroforesis menunjukkan pita DNA gen HbA pada ukuran sekitar 171 bp, meskipun beberapa pita tampak samar. Kesimpulan penelitian menunjukkan bahwa gen HbA berhasil teridentifikasi pada sampel pasien GGK, sedangkan kadar Hb seluruh responden berada di bawah nilai normal.

title: Pengalaman Orang Tua Dalam Menerapkan Pola Asuh Demokratis di Era Digital Pada Anak Usia Dini
abstractText: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh semakin terintegrasinya media digital dalam kehidupan anak usia dini, yang menuntut orang tua untuk menyeimbangkan kebebasan anak dalam berekspresi dengan kebutuhan akan perlindungan dan pengawasan. Urgensi penelitian ini terletak pada pentingnya memahami bagaimana prinsip pola asuh demokratis diterapkan dalam situasi nyata, terutama ketika orang tua menghadapi tantangan dalam mengatur penggunaan gadget, memilih konten, dan membangun kedisiplinan anak. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan pengalaman orang tua dalam menerapkan pola asuh demokratis di era digital. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain naratif yang melibatkan tiga orang tua siswa PAUD Islam Bintang Qur’ani Banjarmasin sebagai informan yang dipilih secara purposif. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara semi-terstruktur, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis melalui transkripsi, pengodean, pengelompokan tema, perbandingan antar-informan, serta verifikasi melalui triangulasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa ketiga informan memberikan kesempatan kepada anak untuk berpartisipasi dalam penggunaan media digital, tetapi dengan tingkat kebebasan yang berbeda. Praktik pengasuhan diwujudkan melalui kesepakatan aturan, pembatasan durasi dan konten, komunikasi dua arah, pendampingan, serta penerapan konsekuensi. Kendala yang dihadapi meliputi penolakan anak ketika waktu penggunaan gadget berakhir, keberadaan konten yang tidak sesuai, dan keterbatasan kemampuan anak dalam menentukan pilihan. Kontribusi penelitian ini adalah memberikan gambaran empiris mengenai pola asuh demokratis yang adaptif, yaitu pengasuhan yang menghargai partisipasi anak sekaligus mempertahankan batasan dan pengawasan sesuai dengan usia, kemampuan, dan kebutuhan perlindungan anak. Temuan ini dapat menjadi bahan pertimbangan bagi orang tua dan lembaga PAUD dalam memperkuat pendampingan penggunaan media digital pada anak usia dini.

title: Hacia un marco metrológico integrado para la gestión de medidores de agua (DN15–DN100): una taxonomía basada en constructos para reducir pérdidas aparentes y mejorar la eficiencia operativa
abstractText: This study develops an integrated taxonomy of water meter management constructs for diameters ranging from DN15 to DN100, positioning metering as a strategic component in water utility performance rather than a purely operational task. The research proposes a seven-construct framework comprising sizing, consumption profiling, calibration, inspection, under-registration/over-registration analysis, homologation, and cubic meter recovery. These constructs are conceptualized as an interdependent system that links hydraulic behavior, metrological accuracy, inspection evidence, and commercial performance. The framework is grounded in recent scientific literature and empirical application within accredited bodies, including a metrology laboratory and an inspection body operating under ISO/IEC 17025 and ISO/IEC 17020 standards. Results demonstrate that integrating technical testing with consumption analytics and decision-making processes enables utilities to reduce apparent water losses, improve billing accuracy, and optimize asset lifecycle management. The study further contributes by translating metrological errors into recoverable economic value, bridging the gap between technical evaluation and financial impact. While the taxonomy is supported by recent literature, its development is based on a selective corpus, highlighting the need for broader bibliometric validation. Overall, the proposed framework provides a scalable and evidence-based approach for modern water utilities seeking to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and governance of water resources.

title: Nicotina, productos de tabaco y salud bucal: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre los efectos de la nicotina y de los productos de tabaco en la salud bucal. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, revisiones narrativas, un análisis de carga mundial de enfermedad y un estudio experimental. Resultados: el tabaquismo aumentó el riesgo de periodontitis, alteró la microcirculación y el microbioma bucal, y redujo la respuesta al tratamiento periodontal y a los implantes. La nicotina afectó la capacidad regenerativa de las células madre dentales. El tabaco se asoció con el cáncer bucal y con las tinciones dentales. Los cigarrillos electrónicos también alteraron los parámetros periodontales. Conclusión: el abandono del consumo mejora la salud periodontal, y el consultorio odontológico es un espacio adecuado para promoverlo.

title: DESIGNING RESILIENT ENTERPRISE SYSTEMS THROUGH AI-DRIVEN DEPENDENCY MAPPING AND IMPACT ANALYSIS
abstractText: Enterprise systems are now often spread across a range of hidden technical and organizational dependencies; technical debt can accumulate, configurations can change, and failures can propagate. Redundancy or post-incident recovery alone is not enough for resilience design; such environments require continuously updated dependency knowledge and credible impact analysis before, during, and after change. This review considers peer-reviewed journal literature published between 2015 and 2024 that is relevant to the dependency mapping and impact analysis of resilient enterprise systems using AI. The studies included in the review are grouped around microservice architecture, process mining, digital twins, graph learning, anomaly detection, explainable artificial intelligence and resilience measurement, as well as AIOps. Based on the literature, it is shown that AI-based mapping can increase observability of runtime relations, aid in change-risk prioritization, and aid in failure localization with architectural models and operational telemetry. There are still gaps in causal validation, cross-layer dependency representation, data quality, explainability and evaluation against real enterprise incidents. There is scholarly value in the field, as resilient design increasingly relies on dynamic, evidence-based knowledge of how enterprise elements behave under stress, change and degradation.
venueName: World Journal of Advanced Engineering Technology and Sciences

title: PERAN MAHASISWA DALAM MENDUKUNG TRANSISI ENERGI BERKELANJUTAN MELALUI TRANSPORTASI RAMAH LINGKUNGAN
abstractText: ABSTRACT The transition toward sustainable energy in the transportation sector depends not only on technological development but also on everyday mobility choices and behaviors, including those of university students as active transportation users. This study aims to understand how university students perceive their role in supporting the transition toward sustainable energy through more environmentally friendly transportation choices, focusing on mode selection, barriers, social influences, and the types of institutional support needed from the university. A qualitative approach was employed involving 10 active students at Universitas Tarumanagara, consisting of one participant in an in-depth interview and nine participants who responded to an open-ended essay questionnaire. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and open-ended questions and analyzed thematically through data familiarization, identification of significant statements, initial coding, code grouping, theme development, and cross-participant comparison. The findings indicate that students' transportation choices are influenced by environmental awareness, while mobility decisions are also shaped by cost, distance, travel time, efficiency, accessibility, comfort, safety, and technical limitations of electric vehicles. Peer influence, experiences with more sustainable transportation modes, and the availability of supportive campus facilities also encourage more sustainable mobility choices. The study concludes that students' role in supporting sustainable transportation is contextual and shaped by the interaction between environmental awareness, mobility needs, social conditions, and the availability of supporting infrastructure. Therefore, promoting sustainable student mobility requires not only individual awareness but also an enabling social and institutional environment. ABSTRAK Transisi energi berkelanjutan pada sektor transportasi tidak hanya bergantung pada perkembangan teknologi, tetapi juga pada pilihan dan perilaku mobilitas masyarakat, termasuk mahasiswa sebagai kelompok pengguna transportasi yang aktif. Penelitian ini bertujuan memahami bagaimana mahasiswa memaknai peran mereka dalam mendukung transisi energi berkelanjutan melalui pilihan transportasi yang lebih ramah lingkungan, dengan fokus pada alasan pemilihan moda, hambatan, pengaruh lingkungan sosial, dan dukungan kampus yang dibutuhkan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan melibatkan 10 mahasiswa aktif Universitas Tarumanagara, yang terdiri atas satu partisipan wawancara mendalam dan sembilan partisipan kuesioner esai. Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara semi-terstruktur dan pertanyaan terbuka, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan analisis tematik melalui tahapan familiarisasi data, identifikasi pernyataan penting, initial coding, pengelompokan kode, pembentukan tema, dan perbandingan antarpartisipan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pilihan transportasi mahasiswa dipengaruhi oleh kesadaran terhadap lingkungan, tetapi keputusan mobilitas juga mempertimbangkan biaya, jarak, waktu tempuh, efisiensi, aksesibilitas, kenyamanan, keamanan, serta keterbatasan teknis kendaraan listrik. Pengaruh teman sebaya, pengalaman menggunakan moda transportasi yang lebih berkelanjutan, dan ketersediaan fasilitas kampus turut mendukung perubahan pilihan mobilitas. Penelitian menyimpulkan bahwa peran mahasiswa dalam mendukung transportasi berkelanjutan bersifat kontekstual dan dipengaruhi oleh interaksi antara kesadaran lingkungan, kebutuhan mobilitas, kondisi sosial, serta dukungan infrastruktur yang tersedia.

title: Edukasi Pentingnya Nutrisi bagi Penderita Tuberkulosis Paru pada Lansia di Puskesmas Sokaraja 1
abstractText: Lansia penderita tuberkulosis (TB) paru rentan mengalami masalah gizi dan memiliki keterbatasan pengetahuan mengenai pentingnya nutrisi selama proses pengobatan. Kegiatan ini bertujuan meningkatkan pengetahuan lansia penderita TB paru mengenai pentingnya nutrisi melalui edukasi kesehatan. Kegiatan menggunakan metode pre-test post-test without control group. Sasaran terdiri atas 7 lansia berusia 60 tahun ke atas penderita TB paru di wilayah kerja Puskesmas Sokaraja 1. Instrumen berupa kuesioner pengetahuan sebanyak sepuluh soal, sedangkan data dianalisis secara deskriptif berdasarkan persentase tingkat pengetahuan sebelum dan sesudah edukasi. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa sebelum edukasi terdapat 4 lansia (57,14%) dengan pengetahuan kurang dan 3 lansia (42,86%) dengan pengetahuan cukup. Setelah edukasi, 5 lansia (71,43%) memiliki pengetahuan baik dan 2 lansia (28,57%) memiliki pengetahuan cukup. Kesimpulannya, edukasi kesehatan melalui ceramah, diskusi, leaflet, video, dan demonstrasi seduhan bubuk daun kelor dapat meningkatkan tingkat pengetahuan lansia mengenai pentingnya nutrisi TB paru.

title: Terapia pulpar y técnicas conservadoras en dientes temporales de menores de seis años: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las técnicas actuales de terapia pulpar y de tratamiento conservador para preservar los dientes temporales con caries en niños menores de seis años. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con metaanálisis, ensayos clínicos aleatorizados y revisiones narrativas. Resultados: la eliminación selectiva de la caries fue una alternativa duradera y costo-efectiva a la excavación por etapas; la terapia pulpar vital mostró buenos resultados incluso con pulpitis; la instrumentación rotatoria redujo el tiempo de la pulpectomía, y el fluoruro diamino de plata detuvo la caries dentinaria con eficacia comparable al tratamiento restaurador atraumático. Conclusión: las técnicas mínimamente invasivas permiten conservar la pieza temporal y reducen la necesidad de extracciones en la primera infancia.

title: SCRAP REDUCTION IN A PLASTIC INJECTION MOLDING COMPANY THROUGH FMEA AND LEAN MANUFACTURING TOOLS
abstractText: The FMEA methodology has been progressively adopted in recent years by organizations across various industrial sectors with the aim of strengthening their competitiveness in an increasingly demanding environment. Complementarily, companies have incorporated Lean Manufacturing tools, such as the Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) indicator, which leads to significant improvements in operational efficiency. This article presents the adaptation of these methodologies and their application in a sector of great impact both in Mexico and worldwide, the plastic injection molding industry, with the purpose of reducing scrap.

title: Células madre en la endodoncia regenerativa: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre el uso de células madre en la endodoncia regenerativa y los factores que condicionan sus resultados. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: ocho revisiones narrativas, dos revisiones sistemáticas, una declaración de posición y cuatro estudios experimentales. Resultados: las células madre de la pulpa dental y de otros tejidos dentales tienen capacidad de diferenciación y se han llevado a la aplicación clínica. Los procedimientos regenerativos se basan en la inducción del sangrado periapical; los andamios, su esterilización y los exosomas condicionan la regeneración, mientras que la nicotina y la senescencia celular la limitan. Conclusión: las células madre son prometedoras en dientes inmaduros con necrosis pulpar, pero la regeneración de una pulpa funcional aún no está demostrada.

title: Efectos de los medicamentos antihipertensivos en la salud bucal de adultos mayores: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre los efectos de los medicamentos antihipertensivos en la salud bucal de los adultos mayores y sus implicaciones para la atención odontológica. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, consensos, guías clínicas y estudios observacionales. Resultados: los efectos descritos fueron la xerostomía y la hiposalivación, más frecuentes con la polifarmacia y los fármacos de acción anticolinérgica; el agrandamiento gingival asociado a los bloqueadores de los canales de calcio; y las reacciones liquenoides, las alteraciones del gusto y el angioedema. La hiposalivación favoreció la caries radicular y la candidiasis. Conclusión: el odontólogo debe revisar la medicación, vigilar la función salival y coordinar con el médico tratante.

title: IMPACT OF THE EATING BEHAVIOR OF STUDENTS AT THE LYCÉE MODERNE DE SONGON (ABIDJAN) ON THEIR NUTRITIONAL STATUS
abstractText: The eating behavior of schoolchildren directly influences their nutritional status and growth. The objective of this study was to describe the eating behavior of students at the Lycée Moderne de Songon (Abidjan) and to assess its impact on their nutritional status. This descriptive and analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 214 students and covered sociodemographic characteristics, anthropometric parameters and eating habits (timing, frequency, carbohydrate and protein sources of meals, sports activity). The study sample comprised 52.34% girls and 47.66% boys, with a mean age of 13.35 ± 1.45 years and a mean body mass index (BMI) of 18.23 ± 2.97 kg/m². The prevalence of underweight was 8.41% and that of overweight 6.54%, and 85.05% of the students had a normal nutritional status. No statistically significant association was observed between nutritional status and the timing of the main meal (p = 0.439), daily meal frequency (p = 0.855), carbohydrate source (p = 0.597), carbohydrate accompaniment (p = 0.794), protein source (p = 0.309), type of sports activity (p = 0.877), its frequency (p = 0.677) or its daily duration (p = 0.185). Although the nutritional status of most students remains satisfactory, the coexistence of underweight and overweight calls for nutritional vigilance in the school setting, beyond the eating behaviors studied here.

title: UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION AND CARRIER-COLLECTION ROBUSTNESS UNDER PHYSICAL TOLERANCES IN A SERIES VERTICAL-JUNCTION SILICON SOLAR CELL
abstractText: This work investigates the propagation of uncertainties in physical parameters to carrier collection in a series vertical-junction silicon solar cell. Starting from an exact dimensionless collection law, uncertainties are introduced in the base thickness H, diffusion coefficient D, carrier lifetime τ, and interface recombination velocities Sf and Sb. For each realization, the diffusion length and the reduced parameters h, f, and b are recalculated, thereby preserving the dependencies induced by the physical transformation. Twenty-seven nominal regimes and four controlled uncertainty amplitudes, from ±5% to ±30%, are investigated using a Monte Carlo campaign of 120,000 realizations per scenario. Robustness is characterized by the coefficient of variation of collection and by R90 = P(C ≥ 0.9 C0). The median coefficient of variation increases from approximately 3.13% at ±5% to 18.94% at ±30%, while the maximum value reaches 37.14%. Over the same range, the median R90 decreases from 100% to approximately 68.12%. At ±30%, some regimes retain R90 close to unity, whereas the least robust regime in the grid reaches approximately 60.17%. The regime of maximum statistical dispersion does not exactly coincide with that of minimum R90. These results show that nominal performance, statistical dispersion, and probabilistic robustness are distinct properties and establish a regime-dependent map for assessing collection robustness under controlled physical uncertainty.

title: Capital Market Reaction to the April 2025 Trading Halt on ESG Leaders Stocks
abstractText: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh kebijakan Trading Halt yang diterapkan Bursa Efek Indonesia pada 8 April 2025 sebagai respons atas penurunan tajam Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan akibat tekanan eksternal, seperti ketegangan geopolitik kawasan dan pengetatan kebijakan moneter Amerika Serikat. Peristiwa tersebut diduga mengandung muatan informasi yang dapat memengaruhi perilaku investor, yang tercermin melalui Abnormal Return, Trading Volume Activity, dan Bid-Ask Spread. Penelitian ini bertujuan menguji ada tidaknya perbedaan ketiga indikator tersebut sebelum dan sesudah peristiwa Trading Halt pada emiten yang tergabung dalam indeks IDX ESG Leaders. Pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain event study digunakan terhadap tiga puluh perusahaan yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling, diamati selama lima belas hari bursa yang terdiri atas tujuh hari sebelum, satu hari peristiwa, dan tujuh hari sesudah tanggal 8 April 2025. Data sekunder berupa harga penutupan harian, volume perdagangan, serta harga bid dan ask diperoleh dari Bursa Efek Indonesia. Pengujian hipotesis dilakukan melalui statistik deskriptif, uji normalitas Shapiro-Wilk, uji Wilcoxon signed rank, dan paired sample t-test. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan terdapat perbedaan Abnormal Return dan Trading Volume Activity yang signifikan, sementara Bid-Ask Spread tidak menunjukkan perbedaan yang signifikan. Temuan ini mengindikasikan bahwa peristiwa Trading Halt mengandung informasi yang direspons investor melalui perubahan harga dan aktivitas perdagangan, tanpa mengubah secara berarti tingkat likuiditas saham berbasis ESG.

title: Tratamiento de la mucositis oral en niños con cáncer: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las intervenciones para la prevención y el tratamiento de la mucositis oral en niños con cáncer. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: guías de práctica clínica, revisiones sistemáticas con metaanálisis, ensayos clínicos aleatorizados y revisiones narrativas. Resultados: la fotobiomodulación fue la intervención con mayor respaldo en la población pediátrica, con reducción de la incidencia, la gravedad y el dolor de la mucositis, aunque con parámetros heterogéneos. Los protocolos de higiene oral son la base del cuidado. El zinc, la miel y la clorhexidina carecen de evidencia pediátrica suficiente. Conclusión: la fotobiomodulación, junto con protocolos de cuidado oral, es la opción más respaldada, pero se requieren ensayos pediátricos con protocolos estandarizados.

Eficacia clínica de las carillas de porcelana: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la eficacia de las carillas de porcelana en términos de supervivencia, complicaciones y factores asociados al éxito clínico. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, ensayos clínicos, estudios observacionales e in vitro y reportes de técnica. Resultados: las carillas feldespáticas y de vitrocerámica mostraron supervivencias elevadas a largo plazo, con fracturas y desprendimientos como complicaciones principales. La adhesión al esmalte se asoció con mayor supervivencia que la adhesión a dentina, y el sellado dentinario inmediato mejoró el comportamiento clínico. Las carillas cerámicas superaron a las de resina compuesta en supervivencia y estabilidad del color. Conclusión: las carillas de porcelana son eficaces y predecibles cuando la preparación es conservadora.

title: Dampak Orang Tua Pekerja Migran terhadap Perkembangan Sosial-Emosional, Pola Interaksi Siswa di MTs NWDI Lepak
abstractText: Parental migration as Indonesian Migrant Workers (PMI) creates a disruption in the domestic caregiving structure, significantly impacting children's social-emotional development at school. Most previous studies have predominantly focused on the family's economic dimension or prematurely concluded that separation from parents triggers extreme juvenile delinquency. This qualitative case study aims to holistically analyze the impact of parental absence on students' emotional development, peer interaction patterns, and the weakening of social bonds within the school environment. Data were collected through in-depth interviews with 12 students from migrant worker families, structured observations within the school setting, and triangulation interviews with Guidance and Counseling (BK) teachers and two Homeroom Teachers (Class VIII and Class IX Homeroom Teachers). Data were interactively analyzed using the analytical lenses of Bronfenbrenner's Ecological Systems Theory, George Herbert Mead's Symbolic Interactionism, and Travis Hirschi's Social Control Theory. The findings indicate that the absence of direct parenting triggers emotional ambivalence and psychological vulnerability among students. In terms of peer interactions, students' behavior is polarized into two contrasting poles of social action: social withdrawal stemming from status inferiority, and reactive behaviors (attention-seeking) as a form of affection compensation. Furthermore, this disruption significantly weakens three elements of students' social bonds: attachment, commitment, and involvement. The novelty of this study demonstrates that the weakening of these social bonds does not necessarily erode students' belief element (conviction in moral values). Consequently, the social-emotional impacts experienced by students do not escalate into destructive delinquency, remaining instead confined to internal emotional turbulence and daily interaction dynamics

title: Periodontitis y su relación con las enfermedades sistémicas: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la relación entre la periodontitis y las enfermedades sistémicas, sus mecanismos y las implicaciones del tratamiento periodontal. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, informes de consenso, revisiones de mecanismos y estudios de carga de enfermedad. Resultados: la periodontitis grave es muy prevalente y genera inflamación sistémica de bajo grado. La relación con la diabetes es bidireccional y el tratamiento periodontal reduce de forma modesta la hemoglobina glucosilada. Se describieron asociaciones con enfermedad cardiovascular, resultados adversos del embarazo, enfermedad de Alzheimer y neumonía por aspiración, sin causalidad demostrada. Conclusión: la periodontitis debe considerarse un factor de riesgo modificable dentro del manejo integral de las enfermedades crónicas.

title: PENGARUH FREKUENSI PENGGUNAAN FILTER WAJAH TIKTOK TERHADAP TINGKAT SELF CONFIDENCE MURID PEREMPUAN SMPN 9 TEGAL
abstractText: ABSTRACT The use of social media, particularly facial filter features on TikTok, has increasingly become common among adolescents and may be associated with self-perception and self-confidence. This study aimed to examine the effect of the frequency of facial filter use on TikTok on the level of self-confidence among female eighth-grade students at SMP Negeri 9 Tegal. This study employed a quantitative approach with an ex post facto design. The population consisted of 108 eighth-grade female students, while the sample comprised 73 students selected using purposive sampling based on the criteria of being active TikTok users and using facial filter features. Data were collected using psychological scales that met validity and reliability requirements, with Cronbach’s Alpha values of 0.935 for the facial filter use variable and 0.927 for the self-confidence variable. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 27 through descriptive analysis, classical assumption tests, simple linear regression, a partial t-test, and the coefficient of determination. The results showed that both the frequency of facial filter use and the students’ self-confidence were categorized as high. The partial t-test yielded a t-value of 8.210, which was greater than the t-table value of 1.994, with a significance value of 0.000 < 0.05, indicating that the alternative hypothesis was accepted. The coefficient of determination (R²) of 0.487 indicated that facial filter use contributed 48.7% to self-confidence, while the remaining 51.3% was influenced by other factors outside the study. Thus, the frequency of facial filter use on TikTok had a positive and significant effect on the self-confidence of female students ABSTRAK Penggunaan media sosial, khususnya fitur filter wajah pada aplikasi TikTok, semakin berkembang di kalangan remaja dan dapat berkaitan dengan pembentukan persepsi diri serta kepercayaan diri. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh frekuensi penggunaan filter wajah di aplikasi TikTok terhadap tingkat kepercayaan diri (self-confidence) murid perempuan kelas VIII di SMP Negeri 9 Tegal. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain ex post facto. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 108 siswi kelas VIII, sedangkan sampel sebanyak 73 siswi dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling dengan kriteria aktif menggunakan TikTok dan fitur filter wajah. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan skala psikologi yang telah memenuhi kriteria validitas dan reliabilitas, dengan nilai Cronbach’s Alpha sebesar 0,935 untuk variabel penggunaan filter wajah dan 0,927 untuk variabel self-confidence. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan SPSS versi 27 melalui analisis deskriptif, uji asumsi klasik, regresi linear sederhana, uji-t parsial, dan koefisien determinasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa frekuensi penggunaan filter wajah dan tingkat self-confidence siswi berada pada kategori tinggi. Uji-t menunjukkan nilai thitung sebesar 8,210 lebih besar daripada ttabel sebesar 1,994 dengan signifikansi 0,000 < 0,05, sehingga Ha diterima. Koefisien determinasi sebesar 0,487 menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan filter wajah memberikan kontribusi sebesar 48,7% terhadap self-confidence, sedangkan 51,3% dipengaruhi faktor lain di luar penelitian. Dengan demikian, frekuensi penggunaan filter wajah di TikTok berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap tingkat self-confidence murid perempuan.

The Influence Of Influencer Credibility and Expertise On Repurchase Intention Of Hmns Perfume: The Mediating Role Of Consumer Trust
abstractText: This study investigates how influencer credibility and expertise shape repurchase intention among consumers of HMNS perfume, with consumer trust positioned as a mediating variable. The fragrance sector has grown rapidly, and digital influencers now play a central role in how consumers form opinions and make choices about scent products. Data were gathered through an online survey involving 144 respondents who had purchased HMNS perfume and had encountered influencer content on social media. The analysis relied on SEM-PLS with SmartPLS 4. The results show that influencer credibility (β = 0.354, t = 5.346, p < 0.001) and expertise (β = 0.465, t = 7.417, p < 0.001) both have positive and significant effects on consumer trust. Consumer trust, in turn, significantly influences repurchase intention (β = 0.508, t = 8.906, p < 0.001). In addition, consumer trust significantly mediates the relationship between credibility (β = 0.180, t = 4.311, p < 0.001) and expertise (β = 0.236, t = 5.733, p < 0.001) on repurchase intention. The model explains 36.7% of the variance in consumer trust and 25.8% of the variance in repurchase intention. These findings suggest that HMNS should work with influencers who are not only well-known but also genuinely credible and knowledgeable about fragrance. Trust turns out to be the key pathway through which influencer qualities lead to repeat purchase intention. This study adds to the influencer marketing literature by showing how trust mediates these relationships for experience-based products like perfume.

title: Inteligencia artificial en ortodoncia, endodoncia e implantología: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las aplicaciones y el rendimiento de la inteligencia artificial en ortodoncia, endodoncia e implantología. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con metaanálisis, revisiones de alcance, revisiones críticas y estudios de desarrollo de algoritmos. Resultados: en ortodoncia, el aprendizaje profundo localizó puntos cefalométricos con precisión elevada y se aplicó a la decisión de extracciones y a la segmentación tomográfica. En endodoncia, detectó lesiones periapicales en radiografías y tomografías con alta sensibilidad. En implantología, la evidencia identificada fue escasa. Conclusión: la inteligencia artificial es una herramienta prometedora de apoyo al diagnóstico, pero requiere validación clínica externa, estándares de publicación y supervisión profesional.

title: Etiología y manejo clínico de la hipomineralización incisivo-molar en pacientes pediátricos: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la etiología y el manejo clínico de la hipomineralización incisivo-molar en pacientes pediátricos. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, una guía de práctica clínica y estudios clínicos. Resultados: la prevalencia mundial ronda el 14 % y la alteración se asocia con mayor experiencia de caries. Su etiología es multifactorial, con factores prenatales, perinatales y posnatales, en especial las enfermedades de la primera infancia y el nacimiento prematuro. El manejo se basa en el diagnóstico temprano, la prevención con flúor, el control de la hipersensibilidad, las restauraciones adhesivas, las coronas preformadas, la infiltración de resina en incisivos y la extracción planificada. Conclusión: el abordaje debe ser precoz y escalonado según la gravedad.

title: KINETIC DETERMINATION OF CYSTEINE BASED ON ITS INHIBITORY EFFECT ON THE SILVER-CATALYSED LIGAND SUBSTITUTION REACTION BETWEEN HEXACYANOFERRATE(II) AND DPQ
abstractText: Cysteine is a biologically important sulfur-containing amino acid that plays a vital role in numerous physiological processes, including protein synthesis, antioxidant defence, detoxification, and cellular redox regulation. Owing to its strong affinity towards soft metal ions such as silver(I), cysteine readily forms stable metal-thiol complexes that significantly influence metal-catalysed reactions. Exploiting this property, the present study describes a simple, rapid, and highly sensitive kinetic spectrophotometric method for the determination of trace amounts of cysteine based on its inhibitory effect on the silver(I)-catalysed ligand substitution reaction between hexacyanoferrate(II) and dipyrido[3,2-f:2′,3′-h]quinoxaline (DPQ). The reaction was monitored spectrophotometrically at 547 nm through the formation of the dark green complex, [Fe(CN)_5 DPQ]^(3-), under optimized experimental conditions of pH 3.0 ± 0.02, temperature 25.0 ± 0.1°C, and ionic strength 0.05 M maintained with potassium nitrate. Linear calibration plots were obtained over a wide concentration range of cysteine using fixed-time kinetic measurements. The proposed method exhibited excellent sensitivity with a detection limit in the sub-micromolar range and demonstrated good precision and reproducibility. The kinetic data were interpreted using a modified Michaelis–Menten model to evaluate the Michaelis constant (Km), catalyst–substrate stability constant (Ks), and catalyst–inhibitor formation constant (KCI). A plausible reaction mechanism explaining the inhibitory behaviour of cysteine through catalyst complexation is also proposed. The developed method provides an inexpensive alternative to sophisticated instrumental techniques for the determination of trace cysteine in analytical and environmental samples.

PENDAMPINGAN PENDAFTARAN DAN PENGGUNAAN QRIS UNTUK MENDUKUNG DIGITALISASI TRANSAKSI UMKM DI NAGORI KARANG SARI SIMALUNGUN
abstractText: Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS) merupakan standar nasional pembayaran berbasis kode QR yang memungkinkan interoperabilitas antarpenyedia layanan pembayaran digital di Indonesia. Meskipun infrastruktur QRIS tersedia secara nasional, penerapannya pada usaha mikro di wilayah perdesaan masih menghadapi hambatan berupa keterbatasan literasi digital dan ketidaktahuan prosedur pendaftaran. Artikel ini menyajikan dokumentasi proses dan evaluasi hasil pendampingan pendaftaran serta penggunaan QRIS pada delapan pelaku UMKM di Nagori Karang Sari, Kabupaten Simalungun. Delapan mitra dipilih secara purposif dan seluruh kegiatan dilaksanakan pada 5–25 Agustus 2026 sebagai bagian dari program Kuliah Kerja Nyata. Evaluasi menggunakan empat indikator berjenjang, yaitu kepemilikan QRIS aktif, keberhasilan simulasi transaksi, kemampuan verifikasi mutasi secara mandiri, dan penerimaan transaksi nyata dari konsumen. Pada akhir kegiatan, seluruh mitra (8/8) memperoleh kode QRIS statis aktif dan menyelesaikan simulasi transaksi. Sebanyak tujuh mitra (7/8) mampu memeriksa mutasi secara mandiri dan menerima setidaknya satu transaksi nyata dari konsumen. Satu mitra belum menerima transaksi nyata karena konsumennya masih menggunakan pembayaran tunai. Hambatan teknis yang ditemukan meliputi ketiadaan akun surel untuk verifikasi dan kebutuhan pelatihan pemeriksaan riwayat transaksi. Hasil penelitian ini terbatas pada delapan mitra dengan periode monitoring singkat sehingga tidak dimaksudkan untuk menggeneralisasi tingkat adopsi QRIS di wilayah tersebut

title: Association of Residential Factors and Platelet-to-Lymphocyte Ratio with Uterine Leiomyoma Occurrence
abstractText: Uterine leiomyoma is the most common benign gynecological tumor and is influenced by various individual, environmental, and inflammatory factors. Residential environmental characteristics and the Platelet-to-Lymphocyte Ratio (PLR) have been proposed as potential factors associated with leiomyoma occurrence. This study aimed to analyze the association between residential factors and PLR with the occurrence of uterine leiomyoma. This study used an observational analytic design with a case-control approach. The study included 256 histopathological medical records from 2020-2023, consisting of 185 patients with uterine leiomyoma as the case group and 71 patients with adenomyosis as the control group. Residential characteristics were classified into urban and rural areas based on the Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS) classification. PLR was calculated by dividing the absolute platelet count by the absolute lymphocyte count, with a cut-off value of 216.86 based on the 75th percentile. Bivariate analysis was performed using the Chi-Square test or Fisher’s Exact Test. Ethical clearance from the Health Research Ethics Committee of PKU Muhammadiyah Hospital, Surakarta, under number 08/KEPK/RS.PKU/IX/2025. Most respondents in both groups lived in urban areas, accounting for 93.51% of the leiomyoma group and 91.55% of the adenomyosis group. No significant association was found between residential area and uterine leiomyoma occurrence (p=0.590). Similarly, PLR was not significantly associated with uterine leiomyoma occurrence (p=0.878). Residential factors and PLR were not significantly associated with the occurrence of uterine leiomyoma in this study.

title: NATURAL INFECTION BY BLACK POINT IN ADVANCED TRITICALE LINES ACROSS THREE CROP SEASONS
abstractText: Three groups of twenty triticale advanced lines were evaluated separately – each group in a different crop season- for their reaction to black point under natural conditions at the Norman E. Borlaug Experimental Station in the Yaqui Valley, Mexico, during crop seasons 2014-2015, 2015-2016, and 2018-2019. Sowing dates for each group were November 19 and 28, 2014, 12 and 19, 2015, and 12 and 22, 2018, respectively. Healthy and infected grains in ten spikes per line were counted. In 2014-2015, infection in the first date ranged from 0 to 13.59 %, with an average of 2.33, and for the second date 0 to 19.9 %, with an average of 3.52. In 2015-2016, infection in the first date ranged from 0.31 to 45.59 %, with an average of 13.08, and for the second date 0.44 to 42.27 %, with an average of 11.69. In 2018-2019, infection in the first date ranged from 0 to 44.73 %, with an average of 4.35, and for the second date 0 to 8.35 %, with an average of 1.15. title: Copper Ion-Guided Self-Assembly of Polyoxometalate-Based Nanosheets for Efficient Photocatalytic Nitrogen Reduction
abstractText: Abstract Photocatalytic nitrogen reduction provides a sustainable pathway for ammonia synthesis, but its efficiency in pure water is limited by rapid charge recombination, insufficient nitrogen activation, and slow proton coupled electron transfer (PCET). Herein, a copper ion-guided self-assembly strategy is used to construct vanadium-doped polyoxometalate-based two-dimensional nanosheets (PMo12-xVx-TTAB-Cu, x = 0–2). TTAB intercalation promotes the formation of a layered structure and enhances nitrogen adsorption, while copper ion bridging establishes Cu–O–Mo/V interface channels for directional charge transport. In situ Kelvin probe force microscopy and quasi in situ X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy show that photoexcited electrons preferentially migrate from Mo/V centers to Cu sites, facilitating charge separation and generating electron-rich Cu centers to activate N2. Vanadium doping further enhances electron buffering capacity and PCET kinetics, thereby promoting N2 hydrogenation. Therefore, PMo10V2-TTAB-Cu achieved an NH3 generation rate of 667.12 μmol g–1 h–1 in pure water, which is 1.7 times and 3.8 times higher than that of PMo11V-TTAB-Cu and PMo12-TTAB-Cu, respectively. In situ DRIFTS and DFT calculations revealed the lateral adsorption configuration of nitrogen and the alternating hydrogenation pathway, in which vanadium doping lowered the key hydrogenation energy barrier. This study demonstrates an efficient strategy for integrating interfacial charge regulation with electronic structure engineering toward efficient solar driven nitrogen fixation.

title: Manejo odontológico de niños con diabetes mellitus y su relación con la periodontitis: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la relación entre la diabetes mellitus y la periodontitis en niños y sobre su manejo odontológico. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, consensos y estudios observacionales y de intervención. Resultados: los niños con diabetes tipo 1 presentaron más placa, inflamación gingival y pérdida de inserción periodontal, en relación con el control metabólico. La relación fue bidireccional. La evidencia sobre la caries fue contradictoria. El tratamiento periodontal redujo la hemoglobina glucosilada en adultos. Conclusión: el manejo odontológico debe basarse en la prevención, la evaluación periodontal periódica, la educación familiar y la coordinación con el equipo médico.

title: Lifecycle Benefit–Cost Analysis of Wood-Frame Residential Buildings in Tornado-Prone Regions of the US
abstractText: Abstract Tornadoes pose a significant threat to residential buildings in the United States, often resulting in extensive damage and loss of life. Despite their destructive potential, most residential building codes currently lack specific requirements for tornado-resistant design, leaving many structures at risk. This study presents a risk-based lifecycle benefit–cost analysis (BCA) framework to assess the economic justification of incorporating up to EF-2 tornado-resistant design measures into wood-frame residential buildings across tornado-prone regions of the US. The analysis integrates probabilistic tornado hazard models with building fragility functions to assess the performance of two design alternatives: a minimum-standard building and an EF-2 tornado-resistant building. A representative one-story, single-family, wood-frame structure is used as the archetype. The lifecycle cost model accounts for both direct and indirect losses, including casualties, relocation, and debris removal. A Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to quantify uncertainty in the estimation of lifecycle costs and benefit–cost ratios. Results show that EF-2 tornado-resistant construction is highly cost-effective in high-risk regions, with benefit–cost ratios reaching up to 13 to 1 over a 50-year service life. The payback period for these mitigation measures ranges from 2 to 3 years in high-risk areas to over 20 years in lower-risk zones. These findings provide strong evidence for expanding the adoption of tornado-resistant construction standards in residential buildings, particularly in tornado-prone areas, to mitigate damage, reduce losses, and improve safety.

title: ACUTE SCAPHOID FRACTURES: RESULTS OF PERCUTANEOUS AND OPEN SURGICAL TREATMENT IN 44 PATIENTS
abstractText: Introduction: Scaphoid fractures account for about 75% of carpal fractures and mainly affect young adults. They are often missed and expose patients to nonunion and avascular necrosis. This study reports our department’s experience with their surgical treatment. Materials and methods: We retrospectively reviewed 44 acute scaphoid fractures operated on between 2019 and 2024. Fractures were classified according to Schernberg. Treatment was percutaneous or open, with screw or Kirschner-wire fixation. Union was assessed on radiographs and functional outcome with the QuickDASH score. Results: Mean age was 32 years (range 17–48), and 95% of patients were men. The mechanism was indirect in 95% of cases. Fractures involved the proximal pole in 22 cases, the upper waist in 16 cases and the tuberosity in 6 cases. Treatment was percutaneous in 36 cases (81.8%) and open in 8 cases (18.2%). Union was achieved in 39 cases (88.6%) after a mean of 6 weeks, at a mean follow-up of 24 months. Complications included 5 nonunions, 4 cases of avascular necrosis, 3 cases of osteoarthritis and 1 malunion. Conclusion: Surgical fixation, especially percutaneous, provides a high union rate. Early diagnosis remains essential: any wrist injury should be considered a scaphoid fracture until proven otherwise.

title: Pengenalan Konsep Peluang Melalui Media Konkret Siswa Berbasis Konteks Sehari-Hari di SMP Negeri 1 Pantai Cermin
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan konsep dasar peluang kepada siswa melalui penggunaan media konkret yang dikaitkan dengan kehidupan sehari-hari. Kegiatan ini dilaksanakan di kelas IX SMP Negeri 1 Pantai Cermin pada 18 September 2026. Metode yang digunakan adalah penelitian tindakan kelas sederhana dengan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, Lembar Kerja Peserta Didik (LKPD), tes akhir (post-test), dan dokumentasi. Media pembelajaran yang digunakan berupa koin, dadu, dan bola warna-warni yang ditempatkan di dalam kotak. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan media konkret membantu siswa memahami konsep peluang yang sebelumnya dianggap abstrak dan sulit dipahami. Melalui kegiatan demonstrasi dan percobaan secara langsung, siswa mulai mampu menentukan ruang sampel, mengenali kejadian, serta menghitung peluang sederhana. Selain itu, siswa menunjukkan keaktifan dan antusiasme selama pembelajaran berlangsung, terutama ketika melakukan percobaan dan berdiskusi dalam kelompok. Penggunaan media konkret juga membantu siswa menghubungkan konsep peluang dengan situasi yang sering dijumpai dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Dengan demikian, pembelajaran peluang melalui media konkret dan pendekatan kontekstual dapat membantu meningkatkan pemahaman konsep serta menciptakan suasana belajar yang lebih aktif, menarik, dan interaktif.

title: From Bureaucracy to Human-Centred Service: Design Thinking in the Making of the M-Paspor Service
abstractText: Digital transformation in public services asks governments to do more than adopt new technology as it asks them to reform public services around what citizens actually need and experience. Indonesia’s M-Paspor is one such attempt. The app-based passport application service was developed to address the limitations of conventional passport services. This paper analyses the creation of the service through the lens of design thinking (DT) combined with the Business Model Canvas (BMC), concentrating on three BMC elements: customer segments, value proposition, and channels. DT is used to understand users’ needs and problems, and how those needs were translated into possible solutions. Collaboratively, BMC is used to map who is served, what value is created, and how that value is delivered through service channels. The appraisal indicates that M-Paspor represents a shift from a service organised around physical attendance to one that is more flexible, better integrated, and oriented towards its users, even though some stages still require face-to-face contact. The analysis also shows that digital service innovation is determined less by technology and significantly more by the fit between user needs, service value, and the channels through which value is delivered. This paper indicates that the approach may be arguably transferable to other public-sector cases, particularly services that struggle with access, queues, lengthy administration, and a high volume of public interaction, and it offers a framework for analysing user-driven service transformation more systematically.Keywords: business model canvas; m-paspor, design thinking, digital transformation, public services, human-centred design

title: Factores psicológicos del bruxismo infantil y sus tratamientos: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre los factores psicológicos asociados al bruxismo infantil y sobre sus tratamientos. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025), con búsqueda específica de estudios latinoamericanos; se incluyeron 15 estudios: consensos, revisiones sistemáticas con metaanálisis, estudios transversales y ensayos clínicos. Resultados: el bruxismo fue frecuente en la infancia, con amplia variación entre estudios. La ansiedad, el estrés y las alteraciones del sueño figuraron entre los factores asociados. Las férulas oclusales protegen los dientes, pero no eliminan la conducta, y la evidencia sobre los tratamientos procede sobre todo de adultos. Conclusión: el bruxismo infantil requiere un abordaje que integre la evaluación psicológica y del sueño; faltan ensayos clínicos en niños y estudios latinoamericanos.

title: Pengaruh Resiliensi Terhadap Psychological Well-Being pada Petugas Pemadam Kebakaran
abstractText: This study aimed to examine the effect of resilience on psychological well-being among firefighters in Kutai Kartanegara Regency, Indonesia. Firefighters are exposed to high job demands, hazardous working conditions, and repeated traumatic incidents, all of which may adversely affect their psychological state. In this context, resilience is considered a potential factor that enables individuals to adapt to stress and maintain psychological well-being. A quantitative approach with a non-experimental associative design was employed. The sample consisted of 162 firefighters from Kutai Kartanegara Regency who participated as respondents. Data were analyzed using simple linear regression. The results indicated that resilience had a positive and significant effect on psychological well-being, with a regression coefficient of 0.266 and a significance value of p = 0.021 (p < 0.05). These findings suggest that higher levels of resilience are associated with higher levels of psychological well-being among firefighters. The coefficient of determination revealed that resilience contributed 8.7% to the variance in psychological well-being, while the remaining 91.3% was influenced by other factors outside the research model. The findings underscore the importance of resilience as a psychological factor related to the well-being of firefighters.
