Efectos del tabaco y de los cigarrillos electrónicos en la salud bucal: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre los efectos del tabaco convencional y de los cigarrillos electrónicos en la salud bucal. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: análisis de carga de enfermedad, revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, revisiones narrativas, estudios transversales y reportes de caso. Resultados: el tabaquismo aumenta el riesgo de periodontitis con relación dosis-respuesta, empeora la respuesta al tratamiento periodontal y a los implantes, altera el microbioma bucal, pigmenta dientes y restauraciones y es carcinógeno. Los cigarrillos electrónicos y el tabaco calentado se asocian también con peores parámetros periodontales, aunque la evidencia es reciente y limitada. Conclusión: ninguna forma de consumo de tabaco o nicotina es inocua para la salud bucal; el cese tabáquico debe integrarse en la consulta odontológica.

title: Beneficios del sistema CAD-CAM en odontología: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre los beneficios del sistema de diseño y fabricación asistidos por computadora (CAD-CAM) en odontología. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, estudios clínicos, estudios in vitro y un reporte de caso. Resultados: el flujo digital redujo el tiempo de trabajo y mostró un ajuste comparable al convencional. Los bloques industriales de cerámica y de composite ofrecieron propiedades mecánicas homogéneas, y las coronas monolíticas de circona y disilicato de litio presentaron alta supervivencia y bajas tasas de fractura. La precisión de los escáneres intraorales dependió del dispositivo y de la extensión de la arcada. Conclusión: el CAD-CAM mejora la eficiencia, la predictibilidad y la calidad de las restauraciones, aunque falta evidencia clínica a largo plazo.

title: Medicina tradicional e interculturalidad en la atención odontológica de pueblos indígenas: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las prácticas culturales, la medicina tradicional y el enfoque intercultural en la atención odontológica de pueblos indígenas, con atención al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, revisiones narrativas, estudios cualitativos, una cohorte y ensayos teóricos. Resultados: las creencias y prácticas tradicionales influyen en la higiene bucal, la alimentación y el uso de servicios. Algunos productos herbales mostraron eficacia comparable a la de productos convencionales frente a la placa y la gingivitis. Los modelos de salud propios y la adherencia terapéutica intercultural favorecen la aceptación de la atención. Conclusión: la atención odontológica de pueblos indígenas requiere integrar los saberes tradicionales con evidencia científica y diálogo intercultural.

title: Salud bucal y acceso a la atención odontológica en pueblos indígenas del Ecuador: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el estado de salud bucal de los pueblos indígenas y las barreras de acceso a la atención odontológica, con énfasis en el Ecuador. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: análisis de carga mundial, revisiones sistemáticas, estudios transversales, una cohorte y un estudio cualitativo. Resultados: las poblaciones indígenas presentaron mayor experiencia de caries que las no indígenas; en el Ecuador, la caries infantil es muy prevalente y se concentra en zonas rurales y amazónicas. Las barreras principales fueron la pobreza, la distancia geográfica, la escasez de servicios y la transición alimentaria. Conclusión: la salud bucal indígena refleja desigualdades estructurales que requieren servicios comunitarios, preventivos y accesibles, además de datos epidemiológicos desagregados por etnia.

title: Calidad de vida en pacientes diagnosticados de cáncer oral: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la calidad de vida de los pacientes diagnosticados de cáncer oral y los factores del tratamiento que la condicionan. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: observacionales, revisiones, consensos y metaanálisis. Resultados: los pacientes tratados presentaron peor calidad de vida general y bucal que los controles. El deterioro fue mayor durante el tratamiento, con recuperación parcial al año. La xerostomía, la mucositis, la disfagia, el trismo y la osteorradionecrosis explicaron buena parte del deterioro. Conclusión: el diagnóstico precoz y el control odontológico de las complicaciones bucales son esenciales para preservar la calidad de vida.

title: Agrimonolide induces endoplasmic reticulum stress-driven immunogenic cell death in ovarian cancer by reducing PFKFB3 expression
Embarazo adolescente y mortalidad materno-infantil en América Latina: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar el impacto del embarazo adolescente en la mortalidad materno-infantil en América Latina y los factores clínicos que median ese riesgo. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: seis revisiones sistemáticas o metaanálisis, cinco estudios observacionales, una revisión Cochrane, dos comentarios y un análisis de estimaciones mundiales. Resultados: la región mantiene una fecundidad adolescente elevada y un deterioro reciente de la mortalidad materna e infantil. El embarazo adolescente se asocia con complicaciones maternas, como la preeclampsia, y la anemia gestacional se relaciona con mortalidad materna, hemorragia posparto, bajo peso al nacer y mortalidad perinatal. Conclusión: prevenir el embarazo adolescente y controlar sus complicaciones es prioritario para reducir la mortalidad materno-infantil.

title: LABEL RELIABILITY BEFORE LABEL ACQUISITION: A COST-ACCOUNTED STUDY OF NEURAL OFDM ADAPTATION
abstractText: Objective: Labels recovered through forward error correction (FEC) can adapt a neural orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) receiver without dedicated training symbols, but an oracle-label gap does not by itself justify transmitting new training frames. We ask whether the gap reflects label correctness, observation selection or label quantity, and whether paid known-payload probes remain worthwhile after full radio costs are charged. Methodology: A coded 64-subcarrier OFDM link with a pretrained recurrent receiver was simulated. A development experiment (32 episodes) separated the three factors at matched update effort. A frozen confirmation (24 episodes at each of two nominal Eb/N0 values, 7.25 and 8 dB) compared a codeword-level zero-syndrome mask, batch-level FEC adaptation, known-payload probes and conventional receivers by error-free user bits per transmitted sample, charging pilots, cyclic prefixes, probe frames and signaling. Key findings: The oracle gap was chiefly a label-correctness effect. The mask, needing no new transmissions, improved efficiency over matched-update FEC adaptation by 0.0419 and 0.0352 bit/sample (95% intervals 0.0395–0.0443 and 0.0326–0.0378). Probes slightly lowered block error rate but lost net efficiency over the registered horizon. Charging measured serialized processing time put the mask below the frozen receiver and a colored-noise conventional receiver in throughput. Conclusion: Ordinary labels should be filtered at codeword level before new training transmissions are purchased. This empirical control result is conditional on one checkpoint and a stable macro channel model, and does not imply that probes are unnecessary at longer horizons or under other impairments.

title: Afecciones bucodentales asociadas al bruxismo en adultos: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las afecciones bucodentales asociadas al bruxismo en adultos y sus implicaciones para el manejo clínico. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, consensos, ensayos clínicos, estudios observacionales y reportes de caso. Resultados: el bruxismo se asoció con dolor de los músculos masticatorios, manifestaciones de trastorno temporomandibular, desgaste y fracturas dentarias, complicaciones de las restauraciones, periodontitis apical, mayor riesgo de fracaso de los implantes y peor calidad de vida relacionada con la salud bucal. Las férulas oclusales protegen los dientes, pero no eliminan la conducta. Conclusión: el bruxismo es un factor de riesgo de múltiples afecciones bucodentales, aunque la evidencia es heterogénea y no permite establecer causalidad.

title: Efectos del piercing oral sobre los dientes y el periodonto: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre los efectos del piercing oral en los tejidos dentarios y periodontales. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, estudios transversales y de casos y controles, consensos y guías clínicas. Resultados: el contacto repetido del adorno con los dientes produjo astillados, fracturas del esmalte y desgaste, sobre todo en incisivos y dientes posteriores. El piercing labial se asoció con recesión gingival vestibular de los incisivos inferiores, y el lingual, con recesión lingual, mayor profundidad de sondaje y pérdida de inserción. Estos efectos aumentaron con el tiempo de uso. Conclusión: el piercing oral es un factor de riesgo de daño dentario y periodontal acumulativo, que requiere información preventiva y control odontológico periódico.

title: The Effects of Dynamic Capabilities, Digital Transformation, and Entrepreneurial Orientation on MSME Marketing Performance in Brebes Regency
abstractText: This study examines the associations of dynamic capabilities, digital transformation, and entrepreneurial orientation with the marketing performance of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in Brebes Regency, Indonesia. The population comprised 222,415 enterprises, and 100 business operators were selected using incidental sampling, with sample size calculated by the Slovin formula at a nominal 10% margin. Questionnaire responses were analyzed using multiple linear regression in SPSS 25 after instrument and regression-assumption assessments. The reported coefficients were positive for dynamic capabilities (B = 0.331; p < .001), digital transformation (B = 0.538; p < .001), and entrepreneurial orientation (B = 0.245; p = .001). The overall model was statistically significant (F = 90.483; p < .001; R² = .739), and digital transformation had the largest reported standardized coefficient (β = 0.482). These findings describe associations within the surveyed enterprises and suggest the relevance of adaptive capabilities, digital practices, and entrepreneurial behavior to MSME marketing activities.

title: Physics-informed deep learning for few-shot damage localization in carbon fiber reinforced polymer composites under thermal variations
HYDRODYNAMIC COEFFICIENTS AND NUMERICAL VERIFICATION OF A RECTANGULAR BARGE: A FREQUENCY-DOMAIN PANEL-METHOD STUDY
abstractText: Rectangular barges are widely used for their high payload capacity and stability, but their bluff geometry creates complex hydrodynamic responses requiring accurate analysis for safe operation. In this study, Hydrodynamic Coefficients and Numerical Verification of a Rectangular Barge: A Frequency-Domain Panel-Method Study was carried out to determine the hydrodynamic behaviour of a 70.0 m × 30.0 m × 7.0 m rectangular barge with 5.0 m draft and 10,762.5 t displacement. The problem addressed is the reliability of panel-method predictions of added mass, radiation damping, wave-excitation forces, and motion responses for a barge. A 3D ANSYS AQWA panel model was used over 0.2–2.0 rad/s for heave, roll, and pitch. Unlike studies reporting hydrodynamic coefficients or motion responses, this work combines coefficient evaluation with mesh convergence, symmetry verification, published comparison, natural-period consistency, and GZ assessment. Results showed heave added mass of 1.54×107 kg at 0.1 rad/s, reducing to 6.33×106 kg at 3.0 rad/s, while roll and pitch added masses decreased from 5.77×10^8 to 2.92×108kg·m² and 2.19×109 to 1.19×109kg·m². Radiation damping reached 5.50×106 N·s/m in heave, 7.00×107N·m·s in roll, and 1.50×109 N·m·s in pitch. Natural periods were 6.22 s, 7.28 s, and 4.84 s, compared with RAO peaks of 6.68 s, 7.35 s, and 5.01 s. Mesh refinement from 3000 to 6000 panels changed the heave RAO peak by 0.31%. Symmetry differences remained below 0.08%, while roll-RAO comparison showed 1.1% period and 7.3% peak differences. GZ reached 2.33 m at 20° and zero near 58°. The results confirm that verified frequency-domain panel modelling can provide hydrodynamic data for barge seakeeping, stability, and design, and recommends mesh verification before application.

title: Anchoring the Oxygen Framework: A Cation-Pinning Strategy for Durable High-Voltage Cycling and Strain Suppression of Ni-Rich Layered Cathodes
abstractText: Abstract Anionic redox reactions (ARRs) in ultrahigh-nickel layered oxides provide additional capacity for high-energy lithium-ion batteries, yet irreversible oxygen charge compensation at high voltage remains a critical challenge. Herein, a tungsten (W)-doping strategy is developed in LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2 (NCM90) to regulate defect–oxygen coupling and stabilize reversible oxygen redox chemistry. Neutron diffraction analysis corroborates that the incorporation of W significantly decreases the intrinsic Li/Ni antisite defect concentration, attenuates the oxygen-redox-active Li–O–Li configurations, alleviates irreversible oxygen oxidation, and consequently inhibits the regeneration of Li/Ni antisite defects over extended cycling. Meanwhile, strong W–O interactions increase oxygen vacancy formation energy, inhibit transition-metal migration, and stabilize the lattice oxygen framework. Combined in situ X-ray diffraction, theoretical calculations, and finite element analysis demonstrate that W-induced defect regulation homogenizes Li+ distribution and alleviates lattice strain accumulation during high-voltage cycling. Consequently, W-doped NCM90 achieves over 90% capacity retention after 100 cycles at 4.6 V and 1 C, exhibiting significantly enhanced cycling stability. This work uncovers the intrinsic coupling between Li/Ni antisite defects and oxygen redox evolution and establishes a defect–oxygen coupling regulation strategy that provides a general framework for designing durable cathode materials with reversible anionic redox chemistry.

title: LONG-TERM VISUAL IMPROVEMENT AFTER SEVERE POST-TRAUMATIC CEREBRAL VISUAL IMPAIRMENT IN A PRESCHOOL CHILD: A CASE REPORT
abstractText: Background: Long-term outcomes after severe post-traumatic cerebral visual impairment (CVI) in children are rarely described, and evidence for vision rehabilitation in this group is limited to small, uncontrolled reports. Case presentation: A 3-year-10-month-old child sustained road-traffic polytrauma with neuroimaging findings interpreted as consistent with hypoxic–ischaemic brain injury. Initial eye examination was normal except for significant hypermetropia, and severe bilateral CVI was diagnosed. The child underwent a 336-session, structured vision rehabilitation programme alongside spectacle correction and occupational therapy. At 7.5 years post-injury, binocular Snellen acuity had improved to 6/9, although the right visual field remained non-responsive throughout follow-up; the origin of this field deficit could not be established without formal perimetry or electrophysiology, and concurrent maturation and refractive change limited causal attribution to any single intervention. Conclusion: Considerable visual recovery can occur even after severe acquired paediatric CVI, and long-term follow-up is needed before a definitive visual prognosis is made, since recovery may continue for years after injury.

title: Uso del flúor en la prevención de la caries dental: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la eficacia y la seguridad de los vehículos de flúor para prevenir la caries dental. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones Cochrane y sistemáticas, guías clínicas, ensayos y estudios observacionales. Resultados: la fluoración del agua redujo la caries en la dentición temporal y permanente, aunque la evidencia contemporánea es menos abundante. Los dentífricos con al menos 1000 ppm mostraron un efecto dependiente de la concentración; el barniz, los enjuagues supervisados y el diamino fluoruro de plata redujeron o detuvieron las lesiones. El riesgo principal es la fluorosis por ingesta excesiva. Conclusión: el flúor es eficaz y seguro cuando la dosis y el vehículo se ajustan a la edad y al riesgo de caries.

title: IDENTIFICATION OF A STRUCTURALLY AND EVOLUTIONARILY CONSERVED 3'→5' PROOFREADING EXONUCLEASE DOMAIN IN THE LARGE L PROTEIN OF HANTAVIRUSES- EMERGING HUMAN PATHOGENS
abstractText: The proofreading 3′→5′ exonuclease not only represents a crucial class of enzymes responsible for maintaining genome integrity across diverse groups of organisms, but also plays a critical role in ensuring replication fidelity. In the non-segmented, positive-strand bat-borne RNA viruses like Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronaviruses (SARS-CoVs and MERS-CoV), it is found along with the methyltransferase (MTase) gene of the non-structural protein 14 (NSP14). In contrast, in the non-segmented, but negative-strand bat-borne RNA viruses such as Marburg, Ebola and Nipah viruses, it has been identified together with a novel type of capping enzyme, viz. guanosine diphosphate polyribonucleotidyltransferase (PRNTase). Hantaviruses, one of the fatal and emerging human pathogens in recent times, belong to segmented, negative-strand RNA viruses and are primarily rodent-borne. Currently, no universally approved vaccine or antiviral therapy exists for all hantavirus infections. The presence of a proofreading (PR) exonuclease domain has not been reported in hantaviruses until now. Interestingly, a putative PR exonuclease domain has been identified for the first time in these viruses within the large L protein, preceding the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp). The newly identified domain belongs to the DEDD superfamily, but exhibits a distinct structural deviation, notably the replacement of the first catalytic triad -DxE- in the Old World hantaviruses with an -NxE- motif in most of the New World hantaviruses, and the use of an invariant tyrosine instead of histidine at the proton acceptor site. This feature closely resembles the DEDD superfamily of PR exonucleases reported in bacterial DNA polymerases I and II and in the DNA-dependent DNA polymerases of DNA viruses. To the best of my knowledge, this study provides the first evidence for the presence of a typical DEDD superfamily of PR exonuclease domain in hantaviruses, and thus, expanding our understanding of the structure and catalytic mechanism of 3′→5′ PR exonucleases in segmented, negative-strand RNA viruses and further presenting a novel structural target for the development of universally effective antiviral therapies against fatal hantavirus infections.

title: Examining spatial nonstationarity in top-down control of mesocarnivores among disparate landscapes

EFFECT OF AN INTEGRATED ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT INTERVENTION ON MALARIA PARASITAEMIA PREVALENCE AMONG ADULTS IN THE ADA WEST AND NORTH TONGU DISTRICTS, GHANA: A CLUSTER-RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL WITH PRE- AND POST-INTERVENTION SURVEYS
abstractText: Malaria control in Ghana's coastal savannah is constrained by outdoor biting and insecticide resistance, yet controlled evidence on environmental management is scarce. This study estimated the effect of an integrated environmental management (IEM) package on malaria parasitaemia among adults. A parallel two-arm cluster-randomised controlled trial was conducted from July to December 2024, with randomisation stratified by district: three sub-district clusters in Ada West District received the intervention, and four in North Tongu District served as controls. The six-month package combined habitat modification, habitat manipulation, targeted larviciding with Bacillus sphaericus, and community health education, while control clusters continued routine malaria control. Independent samples of 700 adults per arm were tested with an HRP2/pLDH rapid diagnostic test at baseline and end-line. The primary contrast was the difference-in-differences (DiD) in prevalence. Parasitaemia fell from 51.9% (95% CI 48.2–55.5) to 42.6% (39.0–46.3) in the intervention arm and rose from 62.3% (58.6–65.8) to 65.1% (61.5–68.6) in the control arm. The DiD was −12.1 percentage points (95% CI −19.4 to −4.9; p = 0.001), and the ratio of odds ratios was 0.61 (0.45–0.82). The effect remained statistically significant when variances were inflated for intra-cluster correlation coefficients below 0.009, but not above. The IEM package was associated with a substantial reduction in adult parasitaemia against a rising control-arm trend. Because only two district strata were randomised and the control district had recent flood exposure, the estimate is best regarded as an upper bound to be confirmed in trials with more clusters.

title: CONTEXT-AWARE DIGITAL TWIN ARCHITECTURES FOR REAL-TIME TRANSPORTATION AND WAREHOUSE OPTIMIZATION IN CLOUD-NATIVE SUPPLY CHAIN PLATFORMS
abstractText: Context-aware digital twins are emerging as enabling architectures for coordinating responses to disruptions across inventory, warehouse, and transportation operations in cloud-based supply-chain platforms. They are important because they can be used to link continually evolving operational representations with optimization services that are able to react to traffic conditions, order arrivals, equipment status, changes in inventory, and facility constraints. This article reviews peer-reviewed journal literature on digital supply-chain twins, warehouse intelligence, dynamic vehicle routing, Internet of Things-enabled logistics, microservice architectures, and computational modelling. Some studies indicate that digital-twin approaches can improve visibility, scenario evaluation, and decision coordination in specific settings, but there is very little evidence of fully integrated real-time optimization of transportation and warehouse operations. Closed-loop orchestration has not been a primary focus of existing implementations, which tend to focus on warehouse simulation or monitoring, route adjustment, or resilience analysis across logistics domains. Other limitations include insufficient semantic interoperability, inadequate model fidelity, inconsistent latency assessment, deployment evidence, and consideration of cybersecurity and human intervention. The field therefore needs architectures that integrates event-driven context management, federated twin models, scalable optimization, auditable decision services, and explicit uncertainty handling.

title: Integrasi IoT, GIS, dan AI untuk Pemantauan Hutan Cerdas Perhutani
abstractText: Transformasi digital Perhutani telah ditopang oleh pemanfaatan sistem informasi geospasial untuk pengumpulan, pemusatan, dan penyajian informasi pengelolaan hutan. Namun, sistem geospasial belum secara otomatis menyediakan pemantauan mikroklimat secara kontinu, analisis risiko multimodal, dan peringatan dini yang terhubung langsung dengan tindak lanjut petugas. Penelitian ini bertujuan merancang kerangka teknologi hutan cerdas yang mengintegrasikan sensor Internet of Things (IoT), komunikasi Long Range (LoRa), Sistem Informasi Geografis (GIS), citra satelit dan wahana udara nirawak (UAV), serta kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk pemantauan kesehatan hutan dan deteksi dini risiko kebakaran pada kawasan yang dikelola Perhutani. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan design science research melalui analisis kebutuhan, perancangan arsitektur, pemodelan skor risiko, simulasi berbasis rentang data UCI Forest Fires, dan penyusunan indikator evaluasi. Kebaruan penelitian terletak pada integrasi GIS Perhutani dengan pemantauan lingkungan berdaya rendah, penilaian risiko multimodal, dan validasi petugas dalam satu siklus operasional tertutup. Hasil simulasi menunjukkan skor rata-rata meningkat dari 0,148 pada kategori rendah menjadi 0,870 pada kategori kritis. Kerangka yang diusulkan memberikan dasar terukur untuk uji percontohan dan kalibrasi menggunakan data lokal Perhutani.

RESISTANCE GENES FROM E. coli ISOLATED FROM BOVINE MEAT IN THE PORT-BOUËT MUNICIPALITY, ABIDJAN (CÔTE D'IVOIRE)
abstractText: One of the major consequences of the misuse of veterinary drugs in livestock farming is the emergence of strains resistant to the antibiotics used. E. coli is very often involved in cases of poisoning. This study aimed to determine the level of circulation of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli associated with meat consumption in Côte d'Ivoire. Microbiological analysis of 150 beef samples (50 from slaughterhouses, 50 from markets, and 50 from braised meat) enabled us to isolate 181 strains of Escherichia coli. These strains were phenotypically and molecularly characterized respectively for their multidrug resistance capability and for the possibility of possessing antibiotic resistance genes: blaSHV, blaIMP, and blaTEM. As results, the E. coli contamination rate was 16% for braised meat and 22% for fresh meat from slaughterhouses and markets. The average load of E. coli in the matrices ranged from 2.2 ± 0.05 to 5.8 ± 0.1 logCFU/g. The prevalence of E. coli was 60.2%, 33.7%, and 06.1% for samples from markets, slaughterhouses, and braised meat, respectively. Of 41 multidrug-resistant E. coli, 29.3% and 17.1% were resistant to the blaSHV and blaIMP resistance genes, respectively. The emergence of antibiotic resistance highlights the need for training in the better use of veterinary drugs.

title: COMPARATIVE EVALUATION OF CREDIT RISK AND LOAN DEFAULT PREDICTION MODELS BY MACHINE LEARNING.
abstractText: Identifying borrower default is a critical challenge in credit risk management, as inaccurate prediction can lead to financial losses and inefficient lending decisions. This study presents a comparative machine learning approach for loan default prediction using the Home Credit Default Risk dataset, which contains financial, demographic, employment, and credit-related information of loan applicants. Four classification algorithms, namely Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting, XG Boost and SVM, are evaluated for their ability to classify applicants according to default risk. The proposed methodology involves feature selection, data preprocessing, median imputation for missing numerical values, categorical data handling, stratified data splitting, model training, and performance evaluation. Fourteen predictive variables related to income, credit amount, annuity, employment, demographic characteristics, vehicle ownership, and external credit scores are considered. The study also addresses class imbalance, as the underrepresentation of default cases may make accuracy alone insufficient for evaluating classification performance. Therefore, accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix, and ROC-AUC are considered for comprehensive model evaluation. The comparative framework analyzes the performance of the selected classification techniques using consistent preprocessing and evaluation criteria. By transforming applicant-related financial and demographic information into predictive risk estimates, the proposed approach provides a systematic framework for loan default assessment. The study demonstrates the applicability of machine learning-based classification techniques to credit risk analysis and provides a structured approach for evaluating potential borrower default risk. The findings can support data-driven credit assessment and assist lending institutions in developing more systematic approaches to loan risk evaluation and decision-making.

title: Inteligencia artificial para predecir patrones epidemiológicos: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre el uso de la inteligencia artificial para predecir patrones epidemiológicos, con énfasis en la salud bucal. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones, análisis de carga de enfermedad, estudios de pronóstico, un ensayo aleatorizado y estudios de predicción. Resultados: el aprendizaje automático permitió pronosticar el dengue con datos climáticos, y los modelos de proyección estimaron la carga futura del cáncer bucal y cervicouterino. En odontología, el aprendizaje profundo mostró buen desempeño para detectar caries en radiografías y fotografías. Conclusión: la inteligencia artificial es útil para la vigilancia y la predicción epidemiológica, pero requiere validación externa, datos representativos y reporte estandarizado.

title: HOUSEHOLD PRACTICES AND PERCEPTIONS OF BOREHOLE WATER IN LAMBANYI MUNICIPALITY GUINEA
abstractText: Domestic boreholes are essential for self-supply in cities with inadequate public water services. This study examines household practices and perceptions of borehole water in Lambanyi, Conakry, Guinea. A descriptive cross-sectional survey covered 383 households in four neighbourhoods from 5 to 25 June 2024. Data collected through a Microsoft Forms questionnaire were processed in Microsoft Excel using descriptive statistics and thematic analysis of open-ended responses. Overall, 305 households (79.6%) reported boreholes as their sole water source, and 360 (94.0%) used them alone or alongside another source. Only 126 households (32.9%) owned a borehole within their compound; 124 of these (98.4%) also had a storage tank. Across the sample, 202 households (52.7%) reported storage facilities. Although 326 households (85.1%) reported no availability or quality problems, 82 (21.4%) reported access difficulties or conflicts. Stomach pain was reported by 52 households (13.6%) and diarrhoea by 25 (6.5%), without clinical confirmation or evidence that borehole water caused these symptoms. Boreholes play a central role in water supply, but their use extends beyond ownership and raises concerns about access and sanitary oversight. Findings are limited to self-reported information from four neighbourhoods. Strengthening the public network, coordinating borehole management and informing households about safe storage and water quality are priorities for local water management.

EVALUATION OF THE DETERMINANTS OF SATISFACTION AMONG PATIENTS CONSULTING A GENERAL PRACTICE IN MOROCCO
abstractText: Introduction: Identifying patients’ priorities and their associations with overall satisfaction may inform quality assessment in general practice. This study examined the importance attributed to care-related items and overall satisfaction among patients attending general practice clinics in Morocco. Materials and methods: This cross-sectional quantitative observational study included adults attending 30 general practice clinics in Rabat, Salé, Kénitra, from March to August 2026. An anonymous, self-administered Google Forms questionnaire assessed overall satisfaction and the perceived importance of 20 care-related items. Participants were recruited by convenience sampling. Results: The analysis included 351 participants: 183 men (52.1%) and 168 women (47.9%). The reported mean age was 31.7 years, and 273 participants (77.8%) were younger than 40 years. Overall, 251 participants (71.5%) reported being satisfied or very satisfied. Pain (59.8%) and medical advice (38.5%) were the most frequent reasons for consultation. The determinants most frequently rated as important or very important were physician competence (94.9%), communication quality (93.2%), material quality and cleanliness (93.2%), and physician reputation (91.5%). Overall satisfaction was significantly associated with physician reputation (p<0.001), office cleanliness (p=0.002), physician competence, communication quality, reception quality and staff quality (all p<0.001), consultation order (p=0.004), equipment quality (p=0.005), and material quality and cleanliness (p<0.001). Conclusion: Respondents attributed importance to professional, interpersonal, and organizational aspects of care. The cross-sectional design limit causal interpretation and generalizability. Further studies should validate these patient-reported priorities.

title: Tratamiento de la agenesia de caninos permanentes: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el diagnóstico, los factores asociados y las opciones de tratamiento de la agenesia de caninos permanentes. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones, un metaanálisis, estudios observacionales y reportes de caso. Resultados: la agenesia de caninos es una de las formas menos frecuentes de agenesia dental, puede ser uni o bilateral, maxilar o mandibular, y se asocia con otras anomalías dentarias, con genes del desarrollo y con síndromes como el de Down. El tratamiento incluyó la conservación del canino temporal, el cierre ortodóncico de espacios, la apertura de espacio con rehabilitación protésica o implantes y el autotrasplante. Conclusión: el tratamiento debe ser individualizado e interdisciplinario, aunque la evidencia procede principalmente de reportes de caso.

title: Hubungan Pola Asuh Orang Tua dan Pergaulan Teman Sebaya Terhadap Motivasi Belajar Remaja Kelas XI di SMAN 6 Kab. Tangerang
abstractText: Motivasi belajar merupakan faktor penting yang mendorong siswa untuk aktif dan tekun dalam mengikuti proses pembelajaran. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui hubungan pola asuh orang tua dan pergaulan teman sebaya dengan motivasi belajar pada remaja kelas XI di SMA Negeri 6 Kabupaten Tangerang. Penelitian kuantitatif dengan desain deskriptif korelatif dan pendekatan cross-sectional dilakukan pada 230 siswa dari populasi 538 siswa dengan teknik stratified random sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner pola asuh orang tua, pergaulan teman sebaya, dan motivasi belajar, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan uji Chi-Square. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa sebagian besar responden memperoleh pola asuh demokratis (83,5%), memiliki pergaulan teman sebaya kategori cukup positif (63,5%), dan memiliki motivasi belajar kategori sedang (63,0%). Uji Chi-Square menunjukkan terdapat hubungan yang signifikan antara pola asuh orang tua dengan motivasi belajar (p = 0,002) dan antara pergaulan teman sebaya dengan motivasi belajar (p < 0,001). Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa pola asuh orang tua dan pergaulan teman sebaya berhubungan dengan motivasi belajar remaja, meskipun keduanya bukan satu-satunya faktor yang menentukan motivasi. Penguatan pola asuh demokratis, hubungan teman sebaya yang positif, dukungan sekolah, dan motivasi intrinsik siswa diperlukan untuk mendukung peningkatan motivasi belajar.

title: Dominant bacterial taxa drive ecosystem multifunctionality under altered precipitation timing in a semiarid grassland
Prevención y detección oportuna de la preeclampsia: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las estrategias de prevención y detección oportuna de la preeclampsia. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: ensayos aleatorizados, estudios diagnósticos, revisiones sistemáticas y guías. Resultados: el cribado combinado del primer trimestre detectó el 82 % de las preeclampsias pretérmino, frente al 41 % con factores de riesgo. Un cociente sFlt-1/PlGF de 38 o menos descartó la enfermedad a una semana. El ácido acetilsalicílico redujo la preeclampsia pretérmino del 4,3 % al 1,6 %, y el calcio redujo el riesgo en mujeres con baja ingesta. Conclusión: el cribado oportuno y la profilaxis dirigida reducen la preeclampsia y sus complicaciones.

title: Tratamientos odontológicos de la maloclusión de clase II: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre los tratamientos ortopédicos, ortodóncicos y quirúrgicos de la maloclusión de clase II y sus resultados. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, ensayos clínicos, estudios retrospectivos y reportes de caso. Resultados: el tratamiento temprano en dos fases redujo el riesgo de traumatismo incisivo, sin otras ventajas claras frente al tratamiento en una fase. Los aparatos funcionales produjeron sobre todo cambios dentoalveolares, con mayor eficacia en el pico puberal. En adultos, la distalización, las extracciones y la cirugía de avance mandibular corrigieron la relación sagital con efectos distintos sobre el perfil y el periodonto. Conclusión: el tratamiento debe elegirse según la edad, el crecimiento y el origen esquelético o dentario de la maloclusión.

title: Katrili-Based Empowerment: A Collaborative Governance Model for Circular Economy Initiatives Utilizing Geothermal Silica Waste in North Sulawesi
abstractText: At PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGE) Area Lahendong, geothermal cooling produces silica scaling previously landfilled, while nearby smallholder farmers faced chronic fertilizer scarcity from limited subsidies and rising input costs. This study examines Katrili-Based Empowerment, a circular-economy initiative converting geothermal silica waste into Katrili, a liquid nano-silica booster fertilizer, through collaborative governance among PGE, the Faculty of Engineering at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), local government, farmer groups, church-based groups, and private partners. Using a descriptive mixed-method approach combining program documentation, in-depth interviews, and structured surveys, the study evaluates outcomes through Social Return on Investment (SROI) and Community Satisfaction Index (IKM) analysis. Since 2023, the program has reached more than 400 farmers in 10 farmer groups. The SROI ratio was 1:2.82 and the IKM score was 96.29% (“very good”), alongside measurable reductions in chemical fertilizer use and greenhouse gas emissions. Intellectual property protection and supportive local government policy recognize the innovation’s novelty and underscore its potential as a replicable social innovation model for other geothermal operating areas.

title: Digitalización de las herramientas de trabajo en odontología: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la digitalización de las herramientas de trabajo en odontología, sus aplicaciones clínicas, su precisión y sus limitaciones. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, revisiones narrativas y estudios in vitro. Resultados: los escáneres intraorales ofrecen una precisión comparable a la de las impresiones convencionales en restauraciones unitarias y de pocas unidades, aunque disminuye en arcadas completas. Los sistemas CAD/CAM y la impresión 3D permiten fabricar restauraciones, prótesis y alineadores con materiales de propiedades estables. La inteligencia artificial y la teleodontología muestran utilidad diagnóstica, con riesgo de sesgo. Conclusión: la digitalización mejora la eficiencia y la previsibilidad del trabajo odontológico, pero exige formación, validación clínica y evaluación de costos.

title: FACTORS ASSOCIATED WITH TUBERCULOSIS TRANSMISSION AMONG HOUSEHOLD CONTACTS OF BACTERIOLOGICALLY CONFIRMED PULMONARY TUBERCULOSIS PATIENTS NAKURU COUNTY: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
abstractText: Introduction: Tuberculosis (TB) remains an important communicable disease and people living in the same household with a person with bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB are at increased risk of TB infection. The World Health Organization recommends systematic screening of household and close contacts and TB preventive treatment for eligible contacts. In 2024, an estimated 14 million household contacts of people who were diagnosed with bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB, were reported globally but only a proportion were evaluated and provided with preventive treatment. Objective: To determine factors associated with tuberculosis transmission among household contact of bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary tuberculosis patients in Nakuru County. Methods: The proposal will use a quantitative cross-sectional approach among household contacts of bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB patients identified in Nakuru County. Eligible contacts will be identified, consented and interviewed using structured questionnaires. TB status and screening information will be obtained from participant assessment and relevant clinical records where available. Data will be coded, entered into Microsoft Excel and analyzed using descriptive analysis. Results: The findings will provide local evidence that can support targeted household contact screening, health education, infection prevention and TB preventive treatment. No results are presented in this proposal project because data collection has not been completed. Conclusion: The study will assess household, environmental, clinical, and preventive factors associated with TB transmission among household contacts. Actually, the study may contribute to improved household level TB prevention and support the ongoing efforts to reduce TB transmission and disease in the community.

title: CONSTRAINTS AND ADAPTATION STRATEGIES REGARDING SOIL AND CLIMATIC CONSTRAINTS IN THE PLATEAU DEPARTMENT, BENIN
abstractText: Tomato production has increased steadily over the last decades in the Plateau department. However, it remains highly exposed to soil and climatic hazards that threaten its sustainability. This research aims to analyze the pedoclimatic constraints and the adaptation strategies developed by producers to cope with these constraints in the Plateau department of Benin. The methodological approach used for this research focuses on the data used, data collection, data processing and results analysis. A total of 379 tomato producers were surveyed using the KoboCollect application for this research. The results show that soil constraints (erosion, soil degradation, overuse of chemical products and soil infertility) and climatic constraints (changes in the rainfall regime, drought and yellowing of tomato leaves) threaten tomato production in the Plateau department. Thus, 22% of producers mention changes in rainy days, 18% prolonged drought, 14% erosion, 18% degradation and 17% soil infertility as the main pedoclimatic constraints. Faced with these constraints, producers develop endogenous adaptation strategies: the use of organic manure (57%), fallowing (95%), crop rotation (65%), mulching, crop association (78%), rescheduling of the agricultural calendar and irrigation (75%).

title: Conocimiento sobre diabetes tipo 2 y actitudes preventivas en pacientes
abstractText: Objetivo: Determinar la relación entre el conocimiento sobre diabetes mellitus tipo 2 (DM2) y las actitudes preventivas en pacientes adultos. Métodos: Estudio cuantitativo, observacional, correlacional y transversal en 80 pacientes con DM2 seleccionados mediante muestreo aleatorio simple de una población de 104 usuarios atendidos entre abril y junio de 2024. Se aplicaron cuestionarios para conocimiento y actitudes preventivas; la tesis original reportó coeficientes alfa de Cronbach de 0,765 y 0,725, respectivamente. Se utilizaron frecuencias, porcentajes y correlación de Spearman. Resultados: Setenta y cinco participantes (93,8%) presentaron conocimiento medio y actitud preventiva favorable, mientras que cinco (6,3%) mostraron conocimiento bajo y actitud medianamente favorable. El conocimiento global se correlacionó de forma positiva y fuerte con la actitud preventiva (rho=0,917; p<0,01). Las dimensiones de conocimiento sobre evolución (rho=0,998; p<0,001) y tratamiento (rho=0,917; p<0,001) también mostraron correlaciones positivas. En la dimensión biológica, 93,8% presentó una actitud favorable; en la dimensión psicoemocional, 93,8% fue clasificado como medianamente favorable. Conclusión: En la muestra estudiada, un mayor conocimiento sobre DM2 se asoció con actitudes preventivas más favorables. La magnitud de la asociación debe interpretarse con cautela por el diseño transversal, el tamaño muestral y la marcada concentración de participantes en pocas categorías.

Implementasi Pendekatan Deep Learning Dalam Pembelajaran Fiqih di MTS Ubudiyah Pangkalan Brandan
abstractText: Penelitian ini dilatar belakangi oleh pentingnya peran guru Fiqih dalam menciptakan pembelajaran yang bermakna dan mendalam di era. Konsep deep learning menjadi pendekatan yang relevan dalam meningkatkan kualitas pembelajaran Fiqih karena menekankan pada pemahaman mendalam, keterlibatan aktif siswa, serta integrasi nilai-nilai spiritual dan sosial.Penelitian ini bertujuan: Bagaimana perencanaan pembelajaran Fiqih berbasis konsep deep learning oleh guru Fiqih di MTs Ubudiyah Pangkalan Brandan, bagaimana prosespelaksanaan pembelajaran Fiqih dengan menerapkan tiga pilar utama deep learning (mindful learning, meaningful learning, dan joyful learning) dalam model tindakan kelas, bagaimana evaluasi setelah diterapkannya pembelajaran berbasis deep learning. Jenis penelitian ini merupakan deskriptif kualitatif, dengan metode pengumpulan data yang dilakukan melalui wawancara, observasi, dan dokumentasi. Teknik analisis data melalui reduksi data, penyajian data, dan kesimpulan atau verifikasi data. Pengujian keabsahan data penelitian ini menggunakan teknik triangulasi sumber, triangulasi teknik, dan triangulasi waktu. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa: Perencanaan pembelajaran Fiqih berbasis konsep deep learning oleh guru dimulai dengen menyususn modul ajar mencakup pertanyaan pemantik, tujuan pembelajarandan alokasi waktu. Proses pelaksanaan pembelajaran Fiqih menerapkan tiga pilar deep learning dalam tindakan kelas mencakup: mengaitkan (mindful learning), mengalami (joyful & meanful learning) dan membuat makna (meanful learning & mindful learning). Evaluasi setelah diterapkannya pembelajaran berbasis deep learning memberikan umpan balik kontribusi positif terhadap efektivitas pembelajaran Fiqih di MTs Ubudiyah Pangkalan Brandan.

title: Transformasi Pembelajaran di Era Digital: Strategi Guru Sekolah Dasar dalam Mewujudkan Pembelajaran yang Inovatif, Inklusif, Dan Bermakna
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis dan mendeskripsikan efektivitas penerapan strategi pembelajaran berbasis media digital interaktif (seperti Wordwall, PowerPoint Interaktif berbasis audio-visual, dan video animasi edukatif) dalam mewujudkan pembelajaran yang inovatif, inklusif, dan bermakna pada peserta didik Sekolah Dasar. Jenis penelitian yang digunakan adalah Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) model Kemmis & Taggart yang dilaksanakan dalam dua siklus, dengan tiap siklus terdiri atas tahapan perencanaan, pelaksanaan, pengamatan, dan refleksi. Subjek penelitian adalah siswa Kelas 1 SD Fase A UPT SPF 106186 Kubah Sentang, Kecamatan Pantai Labu, Kabupaten Deli Serdang pada semester genap tahun ajaran 2025/2026, dengan jumlah total 28 orang (18 siswa perempuan dan 10 siswa laki-laki). Data penelitian dikumpulkan melalui teknik observasi aktivitas siswa, tes hasil belajar (literasi dan numerasi dasar), dokumentasi, serta lembar wawancara reflektif guru. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan peningkatan signifikan pada partisipasi aktif dan ketuntasan hasil belajar siswa. Pada pra-siklus, ketuntasan belajar siswa hanya mencapai 35,71% (10 siswa) dengan rata-rata kelas 61,2. Setelah dilaksanakan Tindakan Siklus I, persentase ketuntasan meningkat menjadi 64,28% (18 siswa) dengan rata-rata nilai 72,5. Selanjutnya, pada Siklus II dengan penyempurnaan diferensiasi media digital dan pendampingan khusus, ketuntasan klasikal berhasil mencapai 89,28% (25 siswa) dengan rata-rata nilai kelas 85,4. Pembelajaran berbasis digital interaktif terbukti mampu menciptakan iklim kelas yang inklusif bagi seluruh siswa laki-laki dan perempuan, meningkatkan keterlibatan emosional serta kognitif, dan memberikan pengalaman belajar yang bermakna sesuai karakteristik anak usia dini pada Fase A Kurikulum Merdeka.

title: ANALYTICAL SOLUTION OF MICROPLASIC POLLUTANT TRANSFER THROUGH AQUIFER IN THE PRESENCE OF SOURCE/SINK
abstractText: An exact analytical solution is developed for the governing one-dimensional advection–dispersion–reaction equation by first separating the steady-state contribution associated with the source/sink term from the transient concentration. The governing advection–dispersion–reaction equation is solved analytically by decomposing the solution into steady-state and transient components, followed by an exponential transformation to eliminate the advective first-derivative term and separation of variables to obtain an eigenfunction expansion for the transient concentration. Finally, we have found the analytical concentration distribution of microplastic pollutants as a function of space and time.This procedure yields an analytical series solution that explicitly describes the transient concentration field.The proposed solution also enables the source and sink cases to be examined within the same mathematical formulation. A positive source term represents continuous addition of microplastics to the aquifer, whereas a negative term represents removal. Consequently, the model can be used to investigate how external loading or removal modifies pollutant persistence, concentration levels, and spatial migration. The analytical expression additionally provides a benchmark for numerical simulations and facilitates sensitivity analysis without requiring repeated numerical discretization.

title: Prevención de enfermedades bucales en adultos mayores: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre las estrategias de prevención de las enfermedades bucales en adultos mayores. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas y narrativas, documentos de posición, estudios de intervención y observacionales, un estudio instrumental y un protocolo clínico. Resultados: la fragilidad oral se asoció con fragilidad física y mortalidad. La educación del personal de residencias, la higiene adaptada a la destreza manual, el retiro nocturno de la prótesis, la revisión de los fármacos que producen sequedad bucal, el tratamiento no invasivo de la caries radicular, la asistencia odontológica regular y los ejercicios orales se describieron como medidas preventivas. Conclusión: la prevención en adultos mayores debe ser multidimensional e integrarse en la atención geriátrica.

Complicaciones intraoperatorias y posoperatorias de la cirugía de terceros molares en adultos: revisión sistemática
abstractText: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre las complicaciones intraoperatorias y posoperatorias de la cirugía de terceros molares en adultos y las medidas para prevenirlas. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, ensayos clínicos y estudios observacionales. Resultados: la extracción de molares próximos al conducto mandibular se asoció con más lesiones del nervio alveolar inferior que la coronectomía. La profilaxis antibiótica redujo la infección y la alveolitis, con más efectos adversos. La fibrina rica en plaquetas redujo la alveolitis y el dolor, y los antiinflamatorios no esteroideos, solos o con paracetamol, superaron a los opioides. Conclusión: las complicaciones son mayoritariamente leves y prevenibles mediante planificación y medidas específicas.

title: Minat Investasi Berkelanjutan Berbasis ESG pada Generasi Z: Analisis Literasi Keuangan, Informasi Media Sosial, Inovasi Teknologi, dan Tren Digitalisasi
abstractText: Penelitian ini menguji pengaruh literasi keuangan, informasi media sosial, inovasi teknologi, dan tren digitalisasi terhadap minat investasi berkelanjutan berbasis Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) pada Generasi Z di Jakarta. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif eksplanatori dengan data primer dari 150 responden yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling (Generasi Z yang pernah berinvestasi di pasar modal) dan dianalisis dengan Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) menggunakan SmartPLS 4.0. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa keempat variabel berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap minat investasi ESG (β = 0,324–0,422; p < 0,001) dan bersama-sama menjelaskan 50,2% varians minat investasi ESG (adjusted R²). Literasi keuangan memiliki pengaruh terbesar. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa penguatan edukasi keuangan dan pengembangan platform investasi digital berpotensi meningkatkan minat Generasi Z pada instrumen berkelanjutan. Karena data bersifat cross-sectional dan sampel diambil secara non-probabilitas di Jakarta, hasil penelitian dibaca sebagai hubungan antarvariabel dan tidak digeneralisasi ke populasi yang lebih luas.

title: Pengaruh Pemanfaatan SIMRS terhadap Kualitas Pelaporan Internal Data 10 Besar Penyakit Rawat Inap di Rumah Sakit Maranatha
abstractText: Pemanfaatan Sistem Informasi Manajemen Rumah Sakit (SIMRS) berperan penting meningkatkan kualitas pelaporan internal data 10 besar penyakit rawat inap. Penelitian ini menganalisis pengaruh pemanfaatan SIMRS terhadap kualitas pelaporan internal di RS Maranatha menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain cross-sectional pada 45 responden dari 51 pengguna SIMRS berdasarkan rumus Slovin. Data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner valid dan reliabel, dianalisis menggunakan regresi linier sederhana. Hasil menunjukkan pemanfaatan SIMRS berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap kualitas pelaporan (t = 9,126; p < 0,001), dengan korelasi 0,812 dan R² sebesar 0,659. Persamaan regresi Y = 11,840 + 0,928X menunjukkan peningkatan pemanfaatan SIMRS diikuti peningkatan kualitas pelaporan. Disimpulkan bahwa pemanfaatan SIMRS berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kualitas pelaporan. RS Maranatha disarankan meningkatkan kompetensi pengguna, pemeliharaan sistem, serta evaluasi SOP berkala.

title: Reconstructing the Pesantren-Based Madrasah Curriculum for Character Development
abstractText: Contemporary Islamic education continues to face challenges in strengthening students' character development through integrated educational systems. This study aimed to analyze (1) the reconstruction of a pesantren-based madrasah curriculum, (2) student management, and (3) character habituation at MTs Unggulan Al-Qodiri 1 Jember. A qualitative approach with a single-case study design was employed. The study was conducted from July to September and involved 10 informants, consisting of the madrasah principal, vice principal for curriculum, vice principal for student affairs, ustadz and ustadzah (teachers), pesantren administrators, mudabbir/mudabbirah (dormitory supervisors), and students. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, participant observation, and document analysis and analyzed using the interactive model of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña. The findings indicate that curriculum reconstruction was implemented through the integration of the national and pesantren curricula, the alignment of school and dormitory regulations, and the establishment of the Organisasi Pelajar Pondok dan Madrasah (OPPM) within a unified institutional system. Student management involved integrated planning, 24-hour supervision, and continuous character assessment supported by monitoring books, integrated report cards, and joint graduation. Character habituation was fostered through religious practices, discipline, honesty, and social etiquette reinforced by the hidden curriculum, teacher role modelling, dormitory life, and continuous supervision. The study concludes that integrating curriculum reconstruction, student management, and character habituation within a unified pesantren-based educational system effectively strengthens students' character development. These findings contribute to the development of an integrated curriculum reconstruction model for strengthening character education in pesantren-based madrasahs.

title: Job Satisfaction and Loyalty among Generation Z: Work-Life Balance and Organizational Culture as Mediators
abstractText: This study examines the effects of Work-Life Balance and Organizational Culture on Employee Loyalty among Generation Z employees, with Job Satisfaction as a mediating variable. The study employed a quantitative explanatory design involving 90 Generation Z employees at PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk Banjarmasin Branch, using saturated sampling. Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling–Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) with SmartPLS 3.2.9. The results show that Work-Life Balance has a positive and significant effect on Job Satisfaction but does not significantly affect Employee Loyalty. Organizational Culture has positive and significant effects on both Job Satisfaction and Employee Loyalty. In contrast, Job Satisfaction does not significantly affect Employee Loyalty and does not mediate the relationships between Work-Life Balance and Employee Loyalty or between Organizational Culture and Employee Loyalty. These findings indicate that factors contributing to Generation Z employees’ job satisfaction do not necessarily translate into organizational loyalty. The study highlights the direct role of Organizational Culture in understanding Generation Z employee loyalty within the food manufacturing context

title: WOMEN’S KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDES, AND PRACTICES REGARDING VOLUNTARY COSMETIC SKIN LIGHTENING: THE CASE OF THE MARKETS IN LIBREVILLE
abstractText: Introduction: Voluntary cosmetic artificial depigmentation (VCAD) is a practice that aims to lighten the skin using depigmenting substances (DS). Understanding the motivations of certain women to engage in artificial depigmentation led us to conduct this study, the purpose of which was to assess women’s level of knowledge and practice regarding artificial depigmentation (AD). Materials and methods: Our study was conducted in Libreville. The following markets served as the setting for our study: the Mont-Bouet Market, the Nkembo Market, the Akébé Market, the Petit Dubaï Market, the Oloumi Market, and the Nzeng-Ayong Market. This was a prospective, descriptive, cross-sectional study conducted over a 4-week period from Monday, April 13, to Sunday, May 3, 2026. We included female customers and female vendors who frequented these markets in our study. Data were collected using a standardized questionnaire, entered into Microsoft Word, and analyzed using EpiInfo version 7.2. Informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to the study. Results: Out of a total of 200 women, 28 used skin-lightening products, representing 14% of the study population. The 26- to 40-year-old age group accounted for the majority of skin-lightening product users (n=15; 53.57%). Single women were in the majority (n=18; 64.29%). Half of the women using skin-lightening products had a high school or college education (n=14; 50%). The majority of women had a good understanding of the definition of VCAD (n=184; 92%); among this group, the primary motivation was the desire to please others (n=140; 70%). Regarding knowledge of the complications of VCAD, the majority of women cited skin cancer (n=197; 98.5%), followed by skin infections (n=45; 22.5%). Among the 200 women, a significant proportion were unaware of depigmenting products (n=66; 33%), the most commonly cited products were topical corticosteroids (n=88; 44%) and hydroquinone (n=30; 15%). Most of the 28 women who used depigmenting products purchased them at markets (n=10; 35.71%). The most common monthly spending range among female users was less than 10,000 FCFA (n=15; 53.58%). The reasons these women gave for continuing to use VCAD were changes in skin color after stopping the use of depigmenting products (n=19; 67.86%). The most commonly used skin-lightening products were primarily fruit acids (n=16; 57.14%) and artisanal skin-lightening creams and soaps with no listed active ingredients (n=7; 25%). Conclusion: Artificial depigmentation remains a major public health problem among young African women; fruit acids are the most commonly used, followed by hydroquinone and topical corticosteroids. Skin complications continue to occur.

title: Hubungan Tingkat Pengetahuan Remaja tentang IMS dengan Sikap Pencegahan IMS pada Siswa di SMAS PGRI 109 Tangerang
abstractText: Infeksi Menular Seksual (IMS) merupakan salah satu persoalan kesehatan yang perlu mendapat perhatian pada kelompok remaja karena berkaitan dengan pengetahuan dan sikap dalam melakukan pencegahan. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengetahui hubungan tingkat pengetahuan remaja tentang IMS dengan sikap pencegahan IMS pada siswa di SMAS PGRI 109 Tangerang. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain deskriptif korelatif dan pendekatan cross-sectional. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 356 siswa kelas X dengan sampel 209 responden yang dipilih menggunakan proportional stratified random sampling. Instrumen penelitian terdiri atas kuesioner pengetahuan IMS dan kuesioner sikap pencegahan IMS. Data dianalisis secara univariat dan bivariat menggunakan uji Pearson Chi-Square. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa 117 responden (56,0%) memiliki tingkat pengetahuan cukup dan 106 responden (50,7%) memiliki sikap pencegahan IMS negatif. Responden dengan pengetahuan baik memiliki sikap positif sebesar 61,8%, sedangkan responden dengan pengetahuan kurang memiliki sikap negatif sebesar 62,5%. Uji Pearson Chi-Square memperoleh p = 0,021. Kesimpulannya, terdapat hubungan yang bermakna antara tingkat pengetahuan remaja tentang IMS dengan sikap pencegahan IMS pada siswa di SMAS PGRI 109 Tangerang.

title: Tunnel/P2 Interlocking Structure Coupled with TiO2 Interface Modification for Synergistically Enhanced Structural Stability of Sodium-Ion Battery Cathodes
abstractText: Abstract Layered Mn-based oxides are promising cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries, which are prone to an irreversible P2-O2 phase transition during cycling and thus exhibit poor cyclic stability. Although tunnel-type Mn-based oxides feature a stable structure, they deliver a low sodium storage capacity. In this work, tunnel/P2 interlocked cathode materials are synthesized by adjusting sodium content and further modified via Ti/Cu co-doping and 1 wt % TiO2 surface coating for synergistic optimization. The results show that Ti/Cu co-doping lowers the proportion of Mn3+ to 42.83% and efficiently restrains Jahn–Teller distortion. The optimized Na0.66Mn0.8Ti0.1Cu0.1O2 achieves an initial discharge specific capacity of 153.7 mAh·g–1 and an average sodium-ion diffusion coefficient of 3.9 × 10–11 cm2·s–1, showing outstanding kinetic performance. The TiO2-coated sample still retains a stable dual-phase structure consisting of a 64.3% P2 phase and a 35.7% tunnel phase, with the average sodium-ion diffusion coefficient increasing to 5.06 × 10–11 cm2·s–1. It maintains a high capacity retention of 91.85% after 50 cycles at 20 mA·g–1 and 67.5% after 200 cycles at 200 mA·g–1. In situ XRD tests confirm that the (002) diffraction peak of the P2 phase shifts reversibly by 0.12° during charge and discharge. The diffraction peaks of the tunnel phase weaken temporarily at high voltage and recover completely after discharge, demonstrating excellent structural reversibility. This study greatly boosts the electrochemical properties of Mn-based cathodes through combined modification strategies, offering solid experimental data and practical references for the development of high-performance cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries.

title: Effect of alternate nostril breathing exercise on blood pressure in hypertensive patients: a literature review
abstractText: Hypertension remains a major health problem in Indonesia. Hypertension is also known as the primary cause of cardiovascular disease, which contributes to a high mortality rate. One of the non-pharmacological approaches to managing hypertension is the alternate nostril breathing exercise to reduce systolic and diastolic blood pressure by modifying the rise and fall of sympathetic and parasympathetic nerve function. The purpose of this literature review is to determine the effect of alternate nostril breathing exercises on reducing blood pressure in hypertensive patients. The literature review method used three databases (PubMed, Google Scholar, and ScienceDirect) and was analyzed using the PICOT strategy. The journals used had a quasi-experimental, pre-experimental, and randomized controlled trial design published between 2019-2024. Based on the 5 journals that have been reviewed, it was found that alternate nostril breathing exercise affects reducing blood pressure in hypertensive patients, both systolic and diastolic blood pressure. Therefore, alternate nostril breathing exercises can be applied as a non-pharmacological therapy for hypertensive patients.

Annealed leap-point sampler for multimodal target distributions
abstractText: Abstract In Bayesian statistics, exploring high-dimensional multimodal posterior distributions poses major challenges for existing MCMC approaches. This paper introduces the annealed leap-point sampler (ALPS), which augments the target distribution state space with modified annealed (cooled) distributions, in contrast to traditional tempering approaches. The coldest state is chosen such that its annealed density is well-approximated locally by a Laplace approximation. This allows for automated setup of a scalable mode-leaping independence sampler. ALPS requires an exploration component to search for the mode locations, which can either be run adaptively in parallel to improve these mode-jumping proposals, or else as a pre-computation step. A theoretical analysis shows that for a d-dimensional problem the coolest temperature level required only needs to be linear in dimension, $$\mathcal {O}\left( d\right) $$ O d , implying that the number of iterations needed for ALPS to converge is $$\mathcal {O}\left( d\right) $$ O d (typically leading to overall complexity $$\mathcal {O}\left( d^3\right) $$ O d 3 when computational cost per iteration is taken into account). ALPS is illustrated on several complex, multimodal distributions that arise from real-world applications. This includes a seemingly-unrelated regression (SUR) model of longitudinal data from U.S. manufacturing firms, as well as a spectral density model that is used in analytical chemistry for identification of molecular biomarkers.

title: Asymptotic approach to singular solutions for the CR Yamabe equation
abstractText: Abstract We study the loss of compactness for optimal functions associated with subcritical approximations of the sharp Folland–Stein–Sobolev embedding in the Heisenberg group. A key ingredient is a fine asymptotic control of the optimal functions by the Jerison–Lee extremals, which attain equality in the critical Sobolev inequality ( JAMS , 1988). When boundary blow-up is ruled out, we show that centered-symmetric maximizers in a Korányi ball concentrate at its center, and we determine the exact blow-up rate and the pointwise asymptotic profile away from the pole, thereby obtaining a natural counterpart of the classical Atkinson–Brezis–Peletier asymptotics for nearly critical Sobolev problems. We then introduce a class of smooth domains geometrically regular near their characteristic set and extend the analysis to this setting, proving one-point concentration, describing the profile by the Dirichlet Green function, and expressing the exact blow-up rate through a Green-function boundary functional arising from the anisotropic Pohozaev identity.

title: Tensor Products of Multimatroids and a Brylawski-Type Formula for the Transition Polynomial
abstractText: Abstract Brylawski’s tensor product formula expresses the Tutte polynomial of the tensor product of two graphs or matroids in terms of Tutte polynomials arising from the tensor factors. Analogous tensor product formulas are known for the Bollobás–Riordan and transition polynomials of graphs embedded in surfaces. We show that these formulas are instances of a more general result for multimatroids by giving a tensor product formula for the multimatroid transition polynomial and showing that Brylawski’s formula and its topological analogues arise from it. Along the way we provide formulas for the transition polynomial of the two-sum and star product of multimatroids.

Language modeling on tabular data: a survey of foundations, techniques and evolution
abstractText: Tabular data, a prevalent data type across various domains, presents unique challenges due to its heterogeneous nature and complex structural relationships. Achieving high predictive performance and robustness in tabular data analysis holds significant promise for numerous applications. Influenced by recent advancements in natural language processing, particularly Transformer architectures, new methods for tabular data modeling have emerged. Early techniques concentrated on pre-training Transformers from scratch, often encountering scalability issues. Subsequently, methods leveraging pre-trained language models like BERT have been developed, which require less data and yield enhanced performance. The recent advent of large language models, such as GPT and LLaMA, has further revolutionized the field, facilitating more advanced and diverse applications with minimal fine-tuning. Despite the growing interest, a comprehensive survey of language modeling techniques for tabular data remains absent. This paper fills this gap by providing a systematic review of the development of language modeling for tabular data, encompassing: (1) a categorization of different tabular data structures and data types; (2) a review of key datasets used in model training and tasks used for evaluation; (3) a summary of modeling techniques including widely-adopted data processing methods, popular architectures, and training objectives; (4) the evolution from adapting traditional Pre-training/Pre-trained language models to the utilization of large language models; (5) an identification of persistent challenges and potential future research directions in language modeling for tabular data analysis. GitHub page associated with this survey is available at: https://github.com/lanxiang1017/Language-Modeling-on-Tabular-Data-Survey.git .

The hive mind is a single reinforcement learning agent
abstractText: Abstract Decision-making is an essential attribute of any intelligent agent or group. Natural systems are known to converge to effective strategies through at least two distinct mechanisms: collective decision-making via imitation of others, and trial-and-error by a single agent. This paper establishes an equivalence between these two paradigms. We show that the emergent distributed cognition (sometimes referred to as the hive mind ) arising from individuals following simple, local imitation-based rules is that of a single online reinforcement learning (RL) agent aggregating action-value samples from many parallel instances of a multi-armed bandit. More specifically, we show that, in the blindly imitative weighted voter model of honey bees’ waggle dance, the update rule through which this macro-agent learns is an RL algorithm that we coin Maynard-Cross Learning . Our analysis implies that a group of individuals following simple imitative strategies can be equivalent to a more complex learning entity, substantiating the idea that group-level intelligence may explain how seemingly irrational individual behaviors are selected in nature. Beyond biology, the framework offers new tools for analyzing economic and social systems where individuals imitate successful strategies, effectively participating in a collective learning process. Our findings may further inform the design of scalable RL-inspired collective systems in artificial domains.

title: A two-stage optimization method for wide-range single-electron quantum magnetic sensing
abstractText: Quantum magnetic sensing is a new paradigm for detecting ultra-weak magnetic fields. Its protocol design concerns the devise of optimal sensing parameters to estimate the underlying signals of interest (SoI). Existing studies mainly rely on adaptive algorithms based on black-box AI models or formula-driven principled searches. However, when the SoI spans a wide range and the quantum sensor has physical constraints, these methods may fail to converge efficiently or optimally, causing prolonged interrogation times and reduced accuracy. This work presents a new protocol using a two-stage optimization method, consisting of a Bayesian neural network to first narrow the SoI range and a federated reinforcement learning agent to subsequently calibrate the SoI. The protocol is developed and evaluated in the challenging context of an NV-center spin system with single-shot readout and limited sensing time; and yet it achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and resource efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art.

title: Predicting Dust Palliative Effectiveness on Unpaved Roads Using a Simple Laboratory Procedure
abstractText: Abstract The effectiveness of palliatives such as hygroscopic salts and synthetic fluids in reducing dust emissions from unpaved roads and surfaces is well established. However, the performance of various products designed to minimize the loss of fine aggregate particles has primarily been assessed by observing the intensity of dust plumes generated by moving vehicles. Currently, there is no standardized laboratory test available to predict the performance of dust palliatives. This study presents a laboratory methodology capable of evaluating the effectiveness of palliatives applied to unpaved aggregate surfaces. The methodology assesses the ability of palliatives to retain dust size particles by measuring the total mass of PM 10 (particulate matter less than 10 μm in diameter) present in material abraded from the treated aggregate surface. Total mass is determined by analyzing PM 10 concentrations in settling dust produced when a sample is propelled into a column. PM 10 concentrations in the column are measured using a commercially available nephelometer. Five different commercially available palliatives are assessed using this methodology: two types of synthetic fluids, two emulsion products, and calcium chloride. Results demonstrate that the proposed test methodology can effectively differentiate between the PM 10 retention capabilities of various palliatives applied at identical application rates. Additionally, the methodology is capable of distinguishing PM 10 retention at different application rates for the same palliative. Among the five products evaluated, one of the emulsion products marginally outperformed the others in terms of retaining dust-sized particles. Most tested products reduced dust-sized particle emissions by 99% or more. The test methodology is straightforward and provides repeatable results. Furthermore, its ability to differentiate PM 10 retention capabilities between different products and application rates highlights its high resolution. Minor limitations exist within the methodology due to the inherent heterogeneity of compacted aggregates; however, these can be mitigated through careful sample preparation.

title: Enhancing forecasting performance in complex commodity markets: A TimeGAN-based approach applied to oil prices
abstractText: This study addresses the challenge of limited historical data and high volatility in oil market forecasting by integrating synthetic time series generated with the generative adversarial networks (TimeGAN) model into the training process of a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network. Statistical and dynamic properties of synthetic and real data are compared using spectral, autocorrelation, and t-SNE analysis. Experimental results show that supplementing real data with TimeGAN-generated sequences significantly improves the MLP’s key metrics (F1-score and ROC AUC) over models trained solely on real data. TimeGAN is shown to reliably replicate the global structural and temporal features of the original data while enhancing the diversity of training samples. The findings highlight the practical value of synthetic data for boosting neural network training efficiency in economic forecasting and underscore the need for further research on validation and generative model optimisation.

title: Gel Formulations of Syzygium myrtifolium Extract and Nanoparticles: Sunscreen, Antioxidant, and Skin Permeation Activities
abstractText: Syzygium myrtifolium, commonly known as red shoot leaves, is rich in flavonoids with potent antioxidant and photoprotective activities, underscoring its potential as a natural source for sunscreen development. Gel formulations were prepared by incorporating both the leaf extract and its nanoparticle form, and their sun protection factor (SPF) and anti-oxidant activities were evaluated. Extracts were obtained via ethanol maceration and subsequently processed into nanoparticles. Both forms were formulated into gels and assessed for physicochemical properties, SPF, antioxidant capacity, and skin permeation. The extract-based gel exhibited superior SPF and antioxidant activity compared to the nanoparticle gel, indicating strong photoprotective potential. These findings highlight S. myrtifolium gel formulations as promising natural photoprotective agents, with ex-tract-based gels emerging as effective sunscreens with antioxidant activity, supporting the development of safer and more sustainable approaches to skin photoprotection.

title: Similar degenerative patterns of olfactory receptor genes in the giant panda and marine carnivores
abstractText: Olfactory receptor (OR) genes constitute the largest mammalian gene family and are critical for olfactory perception and ecological adaptation. OR gene variation is associated with interspecific differences in habitat, diet, and sensory reliance, yet the relative contributions of these ecological factors to OR evolution remain unclear. Here, we systematically analyzed OR repertoires across 25 carnivoran species occupying diverse niches. Marine carnivorans exhibit convergent OR degeneration, with fewer intact genes and ancestral orthologs, higher pseudogene ratios, and relaxed purifying selection compared with terrestrial species. Notably, bamboo-specialized giant pandas display identical degenerative signatures, possessing the smallest intact OR repertoire and most lost ancestral OR groups among terrestrial carnivorans. Our models show habitat primarily shapes intact OR quantity, while dietary specialization governs pseudogenization and selective constraints. These findings reveal convergent OR functional decay under aquatic adaptation and extreme dietary specialization, illustrating complex links between lifestyle and chemosensory genome evolution in mammals.
